name: vikki@friendsofvikki.com
subject: Merry Christmas the unions want more money
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Vikki ID# 20022
body:
Teacher Unions want a very Merry Christmas from your Tax Kicker

View online version https://026s4.mjt.lu/nl3/mMq-q3Q8sy0yF5CQLABAMQ?m=AXAAADD1U7AAAAANctAAAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABld6afapQnKRndSSijng-rhTPi3QAasDI&b=18fb76b0&e=70ce87bc&x=tfLWWkgYyQnikGdJV5PgPO7Do1p91l8ijm7Oi_gXjrQ

Friends,

When Portland comes to the legislature asking for money, they will use words like Portland is the economic engine of Oregon, the cultural center ... I think this time Portland should take a page from rural Oregon. We don't complain about the problems, we go to work to fix the problem. As a daughter of a rancher, I assure you money is not the answer to the problem. I watched my dad search the many piles of collected ‘junk' to fix whatever needed fixin'. Recently, my husband and I spent a few days on the road driving from Prineville to Portland, on to Pendleton and back home again. Driving across Oregon and through little towns like Stanfield, Grass Valley, Madras, Rufus, Pendleton - we saw evidence of reuse and make do all over rural Oregon.

I will be a hard no when all the public school districts show up in short session wanting your tax refund kicker, I will be hard no when the Governor wants $XXX hundreds of millions for Portland. I will just say "Do Better Portland".

We have a saying around the Legislature called "PGE" not that sparky PGE but Portland Gets Everything, PGE. Oregon will continue to fail if PGE continues to happen, we must hold their leadership accountable and until the voters do...

No thanks.

On a different note.

Measure 114 - (the horrible gun control measure barely passed by Portland) was declared unconstitutional by a judge in Harney County. This is great news and will of course be appealed by AG Rosenblum, using our tax dollars to do so. I think we need a full accounting of how many state tax dollars have been wasted on trying to push the gun grab measure forward and then appealing it.

HB2005 (ghost gun bill) should be next to get thrown out - before it even gets going. US Appeals court in New Orleans declared Biden's office lacked the authority to adopt ghost gun regulations. It is not over by any imagination but it looks like it will head to the Supreme Court. Our goal during HB2005 discussion was to make sure it mirrored federal regulation, so when it is thrown at the federal level so is Oregon law.

Christmas parties and friends!

I hope you find some time to spend with family and friends this Christmas season. Our boys are getting to the end of their high school days. We are trying to soak up as much family time as we can!

Lastly, I hope you take advantage of your $100 tax credit by donating to a Political Action Committee dedicated to saving our Oregon. $50 per person tax credit, $100 if filing jointly - don't give it to the state! This can be a candidate or group out there. Farm Bureau, Cattleman's association, and any of the 38 Republicans serving in office in Salem is a good start! It can also be your local city council candidate or commissioner candidate trying to make a difference locally as well.

Merry Christmas,

Vikki
Vikki Breese-Iverson
Proud Mom, REALTOR and Rancher
Oregon State Representative for HD 59

[https://026s4.mjt.lu/img2/026s4/984f143c-d1bd-4951-92a9-a1cdfe5dc1d1/content]

I was able to get out to the communities of Sisters and Terrebonne this past week as well! I really enjoy getting around to every nook and cranny of District 59 to meet and discuss issues in Oregon.

Thank you to Aspen Lakes Golf Course for hosting us, the Cyrus's are such a wonderful family.
[https://026s4.mjt.lu/img2/026s4/40757022-c75f-48b8-8e30-7434c23134a6/content]
[https://026s4.mjt.lu/img2/026s4/cfdb7f08-9cf9-44a0-8924-f4b6862d5e09/content]
In Terrebonne, we discussed the new Highway 97 re-route with the Lower Bridge Road a lot. I am not done having these discussions and will be staying on top of ODOT in regards to this project.
[https://026s4.mjt.lu/img2/026s4/0fc40576-80a7-480c-9707-2011c4493fc7/content]
[https://026s4.mjt.lu/img2/026s4/7490879d-d1f9-4ac5-b300-580b973d236a/content]

We a fun Christmas Party to get to over in Madras as well. Bryan does business with Norton Cattle Company and Tom Norton and they invited us to the fun Christmas Party at New Basin Distillery there in Madras. We had fun catching up with many friends in Jefferson County.
[https://026s4.mjt.lu/img2/026s4/35b8071d-ede1-4e66-9943-424a6df0164e/content]

This e-mail has been sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. click here to unsubscribe https://026s4.mjt.lu/unsub2?hl=en&m=AXAAADD1U7AAAAANctAAAC7a4LMAAAAATF0AAUT4ABvaFABld6afapQnKRndSSijng-rhTPi3QAasDI&b=18fb76b0&e=70ce87bc&x=tfLWWkgYyQnikGdJV5PgPO7Do1p91l8ijm7Oi_gXjrQ.

## Welcome to the MIGOP Newsletter!
Each Monday, the Michigan Republican Party sends important information about what is happening within the party, state, and nation and how you can get involved.
---
|
---
Join fellow Republicans for the annual [MIGOP Christmas Party](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=3765c3e2aa&e=a2af77507c) **tomorrow** , December 12!
For more information about this and other upcoming events, visit the [MIGOP events page](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=ee08f8f5ba&e=a2af77507c).

| [ ](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=66ec0ac90c&e=a2af77507c)
---
**COMING SOON:**_Let My People Go_ is a modern-day deliverance story that presents two distinct but interrelated forms of enslavement in America. The first is achieved by the Deep State’s use of proprietary “black box machines” and rigged election software: altering perceptions and resulting in the **_selection—not election_** —of swamp candidates. The second is lived out as real-life consequences for hundreds of thousands of Americans who gathered and protested the 2020 election on January 6, 2021, many of whom are imprisoned this very day.

Watch the [first](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=31c8d8ce56&e=a2af77507c) and [extended](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=19e586d661&e=a2af77507c) trailers as well as [audience reviews](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=445ccfaaf0&e=a2af77507c) from the screen tests—all on Rumble.
|
---
The Election Security Operations team at the MIGOP is actively seeking Republican volunteers for its 18 areas of responsibility in securing elections. For more information or to sign up, contact Phil O’Halloran at **phil@migop.org**.

|
---
Through the MIGOP Good Neighbor Program, you learn how to (1) identify the precinct in which you live (if you don't already know), (2) find a detailed map of your district (one through 13), and (3) locate other Precinct Delegates in your area. _**Having this knowledge will help you make a greater impact in your community.**_
To learn more about the Good Neighbor Program, contact coordinators Ken Beyer (District 4 Chair) at **kenbeyer@protonmail.com** and Ann Clark (Wayne County Republican Committee Chair) at **annpatriot@protonmail.com**.
|
---
Governor Whitmer continues forcing onto Michiganders what they clearly do not want: this time electric vehicles. On December 5, she signed an executive order that all of the state’s agencies need to move to zero-emission vehicles by 2040.

_**[FTA:](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=0754cd16a0&e=a2af77507c)** “_ _The order follows automakers [hitting](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=46571eaa62&e=a2af77507c) the brakes on EVs as [4,000](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=5e4e7541fa&e=a2af77507c) auto dealers signed a letter asking President Joe Biden to stop mandating the EV transition as EVs are ‘stacking up’_ _on lots.”_

**_W_** _**e’ve**_** _seen this movie before: government agencies targeted first; the rest of Michigan is next._**
|
---
On December 9, Liz Magill resigned as president of the University of Pennsylvania over highly disturbing statements she made at a congressional hearing regarding campus protests about the Hamas-Israeli conflict. The chairman of its board of trustees, Scott Bok, [also resigned](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=c4e44b9274&e=a2af77507c).

_**[FTA](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=b23f6c7a5f&e=a2af77507c)** : __“ Magill generated a firestorm when she did not [say](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=cf6ffac04a&e=a2af77507c) during her testimony before the Committee on Education & the Workforce that calling for the genocide of Jews would violate the school’s code of conduct on bullying and harassment unless ‘the speech turns into conduct.’”_

What is going on at American colleges and universities, particularly the Ivy Leagues? **_Sunlight is the best disinfectant._**
|
---

Stay connected with MIGOP on [X](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=48f87fc2ff&e=a2af77507c) (Twitter), [Truth Social](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=d7eb05b74b&e=a2af77507c), [Telegram](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=9e7a0112b7&e=a2af77507c), [Facebook](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=4792a57500&e=a2af77507c), and [Instagram](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=ab14a1c4f2&e=a2af77507c).

One-hundred twenty Americans lose their lives every day to gun violence. Deadly mass shootings are at a record-high since 2006. Gun violence is tearing families and communities apart and making our schools, places of worship, and other public places we frequent feel less safe. **The majority of Americans support stronger gun regulations.** After helping pass the first congressional action on gun violence in decades last year, Martin is ready to build on this progress and deliver more meaningful change. Martin recently spoke with Boris Sanchez on CNN to explain how the _Gas-Operated Semi-Automatic Firearms Exclusion (GOSAFE) Act_ will help get deadly weapons off the streets and prevent mass shooting tragedies: Martin is a responsible gun owner and hunter who understands the importance of protecting our communities from gun violence while defending the constitutional right to own a firearm for self-defense, hunting, or sporting. That’s exactly what the _GOSAFE Act_ will do. Far too often, gun safety legislation focuses on what a gun looks like rather than how it works. This legislation regulates firearms based on the lethality of their internal mechanisms, not easily modifiable cosmetic features. The _GOSAFE Act_ will also prohibit conversion devices like bump stocks, which allow semi-automatic firearms to increase their rate of fire and essentially operate as machine guns. **It’s a common-sense approach that will save lives.** But extreme groups like the NRA are already lining up to oppose it. **[That’s why Martin is counting on your support to help make this legislation law. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: We want to know more about you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
As someone who has helped grow our movement, we’d love to hear what inspired you to give our campaign.
#
On behalf of our entire team, we want to extend our deep gratitude to you for your generous support to our campaign in the past.
As we strive to build and strengthen our movement, we want to know more about you. We spend a lot of time talking about what Alexandria is fighting for, but a movement is not one-sided. We need to know more about you and why you’re here, so that we can better work together for a brighter future.
[We’d love to hear what has inspired you to become a supporter of our movement. Can you please fill in this quick survey to share the reasons why you support Alexandria and our campaign?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/dec-11-support-survey/?source=em20231211-5460-P_ENG_SUR_GFM&t=1&akid=5460%2E2526796%2EZhJIH6)
**[Start Your Supporter Survey](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/dec-11-support-survey/?source=em20231211-5460-P_ENG_SUR_GFM&t=2&akid=5460%2E2526796%2EZhJIH6)**
We are so grateful for how strong our movement has grown since Alexandria’s historic victory in 2018, and it’s only been possible because of the small-dollar, grassroots contributions from supporters like you.
**You’re the one that’s making this movement possible.** And you’re the one who will determine if it’s successful in the future. While other politicians pick up the phones for lobbyists, we don’t take a dime from special interests — so your opinion is the one that counts.
[We’ll use your responses to help inform our outreach as we strive to grow our movement of people who are ready to take action for a better future. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/dec-11-support-survey/?source=em20231211-5460-P_ENG_SUR_GFM&t=3&akid=5460%2E2526796%2EZhJIH6)
Thank you for being in this fight,
Team AOC

In the past few days, I've received notes from people around New Hampshire and the country, many of whom I had interacted with during my campaign or in the course of my consulting work. Many asked if I was happy to see the presidents of Harvard, MIT and UPenn getting crucified in front of Congress. Others asked if I felt vindicated. These messages were all referring to the fact that my 2022 campaign for the US Senate in New Hampshire contributed to the ending of my time on faculty of Harvard University
My answer to these inquiries has been consistent: I'm horrified by what happened last week and I find no joy in seeing moral confusion among the leaders of some of America's most prestigious universities.
And then, over this past weekend, I had the opportunity to connect with a former colleague who had recently moved to a new position. I hadn't spoken with him since last summer. He summarized (in straightforward language) the cognitive dissonance he and others in academia apparently felt when I announced I was running for the US Senate _**as a Republican**_.
> _Vikram, you 're the son of two working class immigrants! You didn't grow up rich or privileged in anyway. You were a scholarship kid and managed to do really well in school. Heck, you even went on to get a PhD from MIT and then taught at both Harvard and Yale. All of that means to many of us that you're a Democrat, not a Republican. We simply couldn't digest the possibility that you were not one of us. It felt like a betrayal, it forced us to confront a reality that we didn't want to believe, namely that our own perspectives were not universal. **You don 't fit the narrative.** I'm sorry I too fell into that trap and dismissed you just like others did._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..bK2Hxaphd1qidkSLmleCz0j9hDdh1g-9lechFdxbHO0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=139674548)
Another friend texted me a short, but powerful, message: "I concede you were right about higher ed all along." While I may or may not have been "right" about the cancerous culture on campuses across America today, I remain convinced that a focus on identity politics and the labeling of humans according to skin color or sexual orientation is counterproductive. It's diversity of perspective, not identity, that we should seek. In fact, during my campaign for the US senate, I wrote an opinion piece for the _Concord Monitor_ about this very subject, which you can read by clicking on the link below:

## [Unify, don't separate America](https://substack.com/redirect/122c7d3d-8bfa-477f-98b3-a2ea2b48e27d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---|---|---
| August 3, 2022
[](https://substack.com/redirect/122c7d3d-8bfa-477f-98b3-a2ea2b48e27d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Vikram Mansharamani lives in Lincoln and is a candidate for U.S. Senate. Having taught at Harvard for the past five years and Yale for the eight years prior to that, I've had a front-row seat to watch the evolution of our culture on campus. And let me be blunt, it's disturbing.](https://substack.com/redirect/122c7d3d-8bfa-477f-98b3-a2ea2b48e27d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/122c7d3d-8bfa-477f-98b3-a2ea2b48e27d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The testimonies of Harvard University's Claudine Gay, the University of Pennsylvania's Liz Magill, and MIT's Sally Kornbluth in front of Congress were shocking to many of us. Representative Elise Stefanik of New York, a member of the House Education Committee led by Representative Virginia Foxx of North Carolina, completely exposed the ludicrous nature of the rehearsed, lawyer-approved positions of the University leaders. If the subject weren't so deadly serious, one might laugh at the disconnect between their thinking and common sense.
All three presidents confirmed their "_personal_ " discomfort with recent antisemitism but went on to describe their commitment to free speech. (It was as if they had all been coached by the same lawyer...perhaps they were?) When asked whether the universities would do anything if such speech called for the genocide of Jewish people, Claudine Gay's answer left me speechless. I'm paraphrasing, but her answer was basically "only if it translated to action" and thereby became harassment or bullying. My translation of Ms Gay's comments: "if someone is calling for genocide, it's free speech until genocide is committed." Having majored and taught classes in Ethics, Politics, & Economics, I was stunned by the lack of moral clarity on full display.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..bK2Hxaphd1qidkSLmleCz0j9hDdh1g-9lechFdxbHO0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=139674548)
For those that have followed me for some time, you're aware that I spent four years at Yale University as an undergraduate and then four and a half years at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology as a graduate student. I then served on the faculty of Yale University for almost eight years and then spent five years on the faculty of Harvard University. I have won teaching awards and was even helping Harvard raise money for a Professor of Practice position that I would potentially fill.
Yet my time as a teacher and member of the faculty at Harvard came to an abrupt end during the summer of 2022 when I was _de facto_ cancelled by Harvard, an experience I chronicled for the _New Hampshire Union Leader_ and encourage you to read by clicking on the link below:
## [I Was Canceled](https://substack.com/redirect/24fc4119-cb3b-477a-a450-59f5dc9caa9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[](https://substack.com/redirect/24fc4119-cb3b-477a-a450-59f5dc9caa9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[THE IDEALS of the American Revolution are being replaced by a cultural revolution that is tearing America apart. Its foot soldiers push a new orthodoxy -- a new state religion, really -- one that tears down statues of George Washington, teaches our kids that America is racist, and tells them they should pick their genders.](https://substack.com/redirect/24fc4119-cb3b-477a-a450-59f5dc9caa9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

### **So What?**
[The recent rise of antisemitism](https://substack.com/redirect/1b040c5d-6047-4e84-bbb1-a8884fdb47ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on and off campus has warped victimhood in unintelligible ways. **I feel like I have entered some bizarro world in which those who were slaughtered (the actual victims) are called aggressors while terrorists have claimed the mantle of victimhood.** At the roots of this distorted reality is identity-driven thinking, a logic that creates a hierarchy of grievances, an approach to making sense of the world that has been broadly embraced in most academic institutions.
It's become commonplace and acceptable to discuss genocide and the elimination of an entire people (without ramification). And if that doesn't disturb everyone, just think about how such behavior has been normalized in elite academia and perpetuated to the next generation of leaders. [If universities are unwilling to call such behavior what it is -- dangerous and inappropriate hate speech -- then what hope do we have that tomorrow's leaders will have any moral compass](https://substack.com/redirect/70cd70b6-8023-4b2a-ae59-21fc1820911f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
At the time I wrote these pieces, friends, family, and many acquaintances accused me of exaggerating my concerns with campus culture for political gain. Many refused to consider the possibility that I may have shed light on a disturbing dynamic that seemed, at the time, to be getting worse. Identity politics and competitive victimhood were running roughshod over American ideals. Right and wrong had been lost in a sea of relative thinking. This is now obvious to anyone who watched the testimony.
## [My Teaching Philosophy](https://substack.com/redirect/50811777-ebd3-4196-bc43-c947e9cb2ae2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| December 11, 2019

My legal team has filed our closing argument brief in the California State Bar trial seeking to have me disbarred as a lawyer. This has been a surreal, exhausting battle to defend my integrity and legal actions from an onslaught of false charges leveled by radical leftwing lawyers working with lawfare groups. Tragically, many of these false charges were repeated nearly word-for-word by State Bar prosecutors and form the basis of the Bar's prosecution against me. It took months of preparation by me and my legal team to be ready for this trial, which took up an incredible ten weeks of testimony. My legal team has demolished the State Bar's claim that there was no evidence of fraud or illegality in the 2020 elections. Our team put on a wide array of credible witnesses that, for the first time, laid bare in a courtroom many of the illegal and fraudulent activities that occurred in critical states such as Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona and Pennsylvania. It was a constant battle even to present our witnesses as State Bar prosecutors repeatedly objected to evidence we sought to present. Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. The State Bar Court judge has ninety days to publish her decision and put forth any recommendation on discipline she might seek the Bar to impose. But that ruling won't be the end of the case. The decision can be appealed through the State Bar judicial process, and then it can go to the California Supreme Court and also possibly to the US Supreme Court for final determination.

Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. The State Bar Court judge has ninety days to publish her decision and put forth any recommendation on discipline she might seek the Bar to impose. But that ruling won't be the end of the case. The decision can be appealed through the State Bar judicial process, and then it can go to the California Supreme Court and also possibly to the US Supreme Court for final determination. | | The Federalist online news outlet recently published an article noting that I will need to raise $3-3.5 million to contend with the lawfare assault being waged against me. Though I have been blessed with over half a million in donations to my legal defense fund, I have already incurred legal costs of three times that amount. I urgently need your help to move forward with my defense. | | | | As excruciating as the State Bar trial has been, this assault on my good name is just one of several high-profile lawfare attacks I am dealing with. In Georgia, prosecutor Fani Willis has asked the criminal court to begin the trial against me, President Trump and others in early August 2024. She estimates that the trial will last 4-5 months. Note the timing of her prosecution seeking as it does to keep President Trump tied up in a courtroom through the November presidential election and forcing defendants like me to raise unfathomable resources to defend myself for the next year +. The Federalist article made the disturbing but entirely factual observation that "John Eastman has been harassed unceasingly since assisting Trump in 2020 constitutional litigation." That is the very purpose of lawfare. The radicals desire to make the process so painful and expensive, and the punishment they seek to exact so steep, that no conservative lawyer will ever again challenge the radical left. The Federalist reported my reaction to this lawfare assault: "The whole premise here is: 'The government has spoken and you continue to say otherwise. Therefore you must be lying.'" | | As difficult as these past months have been, it's clear to me that what my family and I have endured thus far because I had the courage to assist President Trump bring lawful, substantive allegations of election illegality before courts and appropriate elections officials pales in comparison to what we still face. If the State Bar judge rules against me and recommends that I be disbarred, I have the right to appeal but my law license will be suspended in the process. This will cripple my ability to earn a living doing what I have loved and excelled at for decades. Meanwhile, I face a highly-partisan prosecutor in Georgia who is determined to put me in prison for years to come. That's on top of being named an unindicted co-conspirator in federal prosecutor Jack Smith's case in Washington against President Trump. And all the while the US Supreme Court is being asked to disbar me from practicing law in federal courts. They are trying to completely destroy me. I am categorically innocent of all the charges against me and I am doing everything in my power to defend myself and expose the truth. But an unfortunate component of exposing the truth against a government that has spoken, is that individual power is limited by the sheer size and overwhelming cost of the attacks that have been mobilized against me. I'm $1 million in the hole already on top of what my legal defense fund has covered, and I need to raise an additional $1 million by February to defend myself in the Georgia prosecution. My wife and I have worked hard all our lives to earn a middle-class living for our family. We have no way to handle the $3 million+ in legal expenses that this lawfare assault will cost. We're completely dependent on the generosity of people of good will like you to help. During this pivotal month of December, I ask you to to my legal defense fund so that I might erase the deficit that now exists and be in a position to continue my aggressive legal defense as we move into 2024. If at all possible, please consider making a pledge to contribute an amount of your choosing on a . With the Georgia prosecution likely taking up much if not all of 2024, knowing that I can count on your support each month would be a real blessing and source of comfort. | | | | In closing, I ask that you continue to keep me and my family in your prayers. subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37786%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0clWTlKuidYMaPKVDb64mQ&sysid=1)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you’d like to give online, here’s a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37787%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=A9st3sg794o%2b7D0SXhqWew&sysid=1)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37788%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IJquIUiI2QWBM08lX7fwnw&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37789%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lOgfmjTCRo%2fJZjNDxPtbig&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686462%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5BF9ZbTowtUJXNmGFTgDuw&sysid=1)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you’d like to give online, here’s a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686463%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G3b8a8LmY%2bCsEIfkPksq6g&sysid=1)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686464%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0GGxH0BZPX5UHvWajdt%2f1w&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686475%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=88xWkk%2bcC%2fiUbrLaBcML6A&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

American Update
---
_625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314_

Fellow American,

Care, no matter what.

Parenthood's pregnancy resolution services are devoted to
abortions, the purposeful ending of an unborn baby's life.

Does 97.2% of cases brought to
Planned Parenthood that end in the death of an innocent child
sound like "care" to you?

Planned Parenthood cares only
about the business. It preys on the vulnerable, thrives on

more profit in their pockets.

At SBA Pro-Life America, we are

innocent babies. In the last 10 years, Planned Parenthood has the

We cannot be the only voice

The lies, manipulation, and

I can't tell you how
important your commitment is today to the pro-life movement and

For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser

Pro-Life America

name: Congressman Paul Broun
subject: Sign the petition to ban transgender child mutilation
body:
Ban Child Mutilation Nationwide

Dear Concerned American,

Should so-called doctors be allowed to
sexually mutilate or chemically sterilize children - even
children as young as 8 years for girls and 10 years for boys?

Should publicly-funded schools be permitted
to promote this radical trans-sexual abuse, often behind the
backs of parents?

I hope you say ABSOLUTELY NOT!

Yet it is happening every day in America. In
fact, an insider report from a horrified worker at a Missouri
Children's Hospital revealed that the number of children sent for
"gender transition" has increased by more than 400% in the last
five years.

That's why I'm emailing you today asking you
to sign your petition to your U.S. Representative and Senators
demanding they take immediate action to ban the transgender child
sexual mutilation and chemical castration procedures.

I am former U.S. Congressman Paul Broun, and
I'm more determined than ever to stop the worldwide tide of
Leftism I see targeting our children and grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of members and
supporters fighting back against the radical anti-family LGBT
ideology that has swept through our schools, media, and
entertainment, mercilessly attacking the relationships between
children and their parents and destroying family morality and
faith.

Will you join with millions of pro-family
Citizens to defend our children from transgender child sexual
mutilation?

Click here to sign the petition to Congress
demanding they ban all gender transition procedures for minors
immediately!

Puberty blockers, hormone supplements, and
drastic sexual organ surgery are all procedures with horrific
side effects that children cannot fully grasp. And in a sea of
lies and misinformation, few adults understand the true horror.

Make no mistake, the transgender lobby wants
them confused and isolated from any dissenting voices.

*** I've seen an entire generation of youth
come out of their schools confused and assaulted by the
transgender ideology attacking gender and their sense of self,
persuading them to seek poisonous and severely harmful procedures
to change their bodies to "fit in" with the transgender world.

*** I've seen families torn to pieces as the
newest generation of children, who are fed radical transgender
values with their cereal, clash with bewildered parents over a
child's so-called" gender identity."

*** In a growing number of States, children
are encouraged to hide their planned mutilations or chemical
castrations from their parents by teachers and counselors.

*** Meanwhile, the transgender lobby rabidly
shuts down or "cancels" any dissenting voices or studies on the
harmful effects of child sexual mutilation.

*** They even more rabidly suppress any study
of the massive number of children who abandon gender transition
after the fact...

... and are left with bitter regrets, twisted
bodies and awful consequences.
The best way to put a stop to it all is by
passing a flat-out Federal ban on administering these procedures
to minors.

Our children, the most vulnerable members of
our society, are being conned into irreversible procedures that
alter their bodies and lives forever.

This is not a matter of choice or identity -
it's a matter of safety and common sense. Minors are not equipped
with the life experience or emotional maturity to make such
grave, scarring, and often irreversible decisions about their
bodies and their futures.

Sign your petition today demanding Congress
step in and protect our children from transgender mutilation.

14 states have already passed bans on
transgender child sexual mutilation, though 2 are being
challenged in court.

But states like California and New York will
not follow suit willingly, and the transgender lobby is howling
for blood at the restrictions being placed on them.

That's why, once you've signed, I ask you to
chip in with a modest contribution to help CitizenGO bring other
Americans into the fight against child sexual mutilation. Even a
gift of $10 or $25 will be a big boost.

The success of this campaign relies on the
power of Citizens standing together to make our voices heard, and
every extra dollar counts when we're fighting to counter the
transgender lobby's pervasive ideology.

So please, sign your petition, share, and
chip in with a quick $10 or $25 contribution to help CitizenGO
recruit more signers and win the fight.

In addition to recruiting more petition
signers to increase the impact of our campaign, your contribution
will help fund:

Hard-hitting advertisements to highlight
and draw attention to the horrible practices of transgender
centers.
Targeted petition deliveries to key
elected officials demanding they take action to defend children.
Phone calls to likely supporters to raise
awareness and recruit new members.
Radio and TV ads exposing everything the
transgender ideology is inflicting on our children, should funds
permit.

So once you have signed, I ask that you
make a contribution of $10 or $25 to CitizenGO, or perhaps an
even more generous gift of $50 or $100, to help expand their
recruitment and to fund all of these plans in CitizenGO's fight
to stop child sexual mutilation.

So please sign your petition, share, and chip
in with a generous contribution of $10 or $25, or perhaps an even
more generous gift of $50 or $100 today.

Thank you for standing with us in this
crucial fight for our children's future.

Sincerely,

Paul C. Broun (MD)
U.S. Congressman Georgia 10 Ret.

P.S. I'm more determined than ever to stop
the worldwide tide of Leftism I see targeting our children and
grandchildren.

CitizenGO represents millions of members and
supporters fighting back against the radical anti-family LGBT
ideology, and I want every pro-sanity American to band together
to put a stop to child sexual mutilation and chemical castration.

The best way to do that is with a Federal ban
on performing Transgender procedures on minors, and CitizenGO is
launching a campaign to do just that. But it will take people
power to succeed.

That's why I'm counting on you to sign your
petition, and then go on to add a modest $10 or $25
contribution, or perhaps an even more generous gift of $50 or
$100, to help CitizenGO fight to ban child sexual mutilation.

In addition to signing your petition and
donating, I need you to share it with your friends and family who
share our values so they can have the opportunity to sign as
well. CitizenGO's petition page makes it super easy to share in a
way you prefer.

CitizenGO is a community of
active citizens that works to ensure that human life, the family
and our freedoms are respected worldwide. CitizenGO members live
in every nation of the world. Our team is spread across 16
countries on 5 continents and operates in 12 languages. Learn
about CitizenGO here or follow us on Facebook or Twitter.

Not produced or emailed at
taxpayer expense.

name: Andrew Horne
subject: Andrew Horne - December Campaign Update!
body:
Friends!

The last few weeks have been wonderful. Thank you so much for your support.

A key metric for our campaign is the signatures we need to be on the ballot. We had to get 1,550, and as of today we have over **3,300!** The best part is 1,200 of these signatures are online through the Secretary of State, and no one can dispute them. We are in an incredibly strong position!

As you already know, my core issues revolve around Public Education, Gun Safety, and Women's Rights. Here is a photo from a few weeks ago with Jodi Liggett, a fierce women’s advocate, and Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes at the re-branding event for Reproductive Freedom for All.

I wanted to take a moment to highlight some **volunteer opportunities** within the campaign. Your support is invaluable, and I believe that everyone has unique skills and passions to contribute. Here are a few ways you can get involved:
**[www.horneforarizona.com/getinvolved](http://www.horneforarizona.com/getinvolved)**

**Postcard Campaign:**
Writing postcards to friends and neighbors is a personal and impactful way to spread our message. It's a great opportunity to connect with the community on a grassroots level.

**Social Media Engagement:**
If you're a social media enthusiast, we'd love your help in amplifying our message online. Your posts and shares can make a significant impact in reaching a broader audience and fostering community engagement.

**Door-to-Door Canvassing:**
For those who enjoy face-to-face interactions, door-to-door canvassing is an excellent way to directly engage with voters. Consider taking part in signature collection in your neighborhood or at public spaces like the library or farmers market.

**Phone Banking:**
Join our phone banking team to connect with voters in the district. Your calls make a difference, providing valuable information and addressing any concerns they may have.

**Neighborhood Meet and Greet:**
Host a neighborhood meet and greet to create a space for community members to come together, share their thoughts, and learn more about the campaign. These informal gatherings are essential for building a strong network of support.

Your involvement is crucial to the success of this campaign, and I encourage you to choose the opportunity that resonates most with your interests and comfort level. If you're interested in any of these options or have other ideas in mind, please reach out. We also have a campaign slack channel if you are interested in joining.

Remember, I'm here for you. Feel free to call or email anytime. Your input is extremely important.

Thank you,

Andrew Horne
‪(480) 256-9332‬
[www.HorneForArizona.com](http://www.HorneForArizona.com)

## Penn President Resigns Over Testimony
University of Pennsylvania President Liz Magill [resigned this weekend](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9Xt0hfizJNlZONYkz28w2GNOEWvqX89YeMOt9agp254oQQ8GhFdcN4vSBMq5MsE6DdNadhn3-iIgrBM-nCnOPR7ReSUjsE0fP7so8624GtPI0ME0ebYKtUAZjNF0rki8-abWSbMrmkCcjPOAYQZiJYhRFQfQRt476OabXRlb5cLSHTp1cV1XzmtEI4uuAyNZ6Qlqo40qS_tSJrma4NktnBynT80j60oPNpoG1r7hFw5EbXoNNTNpiTEYJwPO4Ttl0Dglklw37eyIqOwz7vDrPIOLLvzWY9AjV4PP2fO8GvYNq) in the backlash from her testimony in Congress last week about handling antisemitism on campus. Scott Bok, chairman of Penn's board of trustees, also resigned. Critics in Congress have called for the resignation of the presidents of Harvard and MIT as well, who also refused to directly condemn calls for Jewish genocide as hate speech. [Two mobile vans ](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9XqaXJHmOXCKoj3-1IoFRPb7IyT5uAu81I7QXXRbPCP54v3-sbrdIm43eV-Zy5MxDLfiYT06mi97RXZ6kBnpYVWXnNmofJZriT_o2fdLO4Sqh6x_XupH5Uc-DeBC3hrNz3L9mdWkrNLpnAYgrCQZGCCGUcsm5YRP89J5hhL2LjZzChyipXv3OSpy13wmLKNdNwlWrHBY12Y1v1fe_E9BQtC9fOnSsWpzbu8FJVt-dN_oltnAvl-VtVss7wG22rcYrxRPAJTye5Z7t-wPkJjvjcy6xKJoimVBuj00vTcetlrvR)at Harvard called for President Claudine Gay to step down. "One down. Two to go," said [House Rep. Elise Stefanik,](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9XuMCzTn2Cp8KP0MD96vtIxbbNDsSZYCS56UmPhlz09kMoRGM-8HMgHha180B5MrxKuIDl5SOatwtHB2f25xLaGl57C3KHkdrSnxKunYbfbgvOK-0ew6bSpgLpuuiO3wAS77Z_k92LwK1ZUHL4RYZk5WZ7i_l3JgTvQ1K_qMvbWSv3_3xQ882lAH7ea8ejSZ4c_JJbo-ZTchMGOq7tkbW9y1q_s2jKQmBFTSL8mBw3FGoiUqVweWdAOzNL68Lnpr3DP9qb0wfVGBzv1xfaLuyezbTMuXDiTvm3mXNiYOPEEyGPgmeERDuJzNNjs3_JMURRg%3D%3D) who posed the antisemitism question to the college presidents at Tuesday's hearing. The House has opened an investigation into speech codes at the three campuses.
## Ohtani Signs $700 Million Deal with Dodgers
Baseball superstar Shohei Ohtani has signed [the biggest free-agent deal in history](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9XqaXJHmOXCKoj3-1IoFRPb52q0ZpG4fV3c0E7dPmIyOteOcndD2elRCXM3MsHyEAPp17l2V6ToYfuMBKNqy6GjLIkLStqfJiKfxnRvMqhHqkT6SZ8eZKnzHzeToV1GiVKz4qqbou4XsGxJdfFVTwpYUuC3WfLSn0CWxD8LDityx9idCvS0dNomMbnlGqVyHzHdtaVmlMApianmPoxN6iIzRwm6zjeT8-MrJqZL127WSDoQPTmaRmi_YNC1-v6QCniY4E8WeHb6zWQ6ZVeJp6USI%3D), agreeing to a 10-year contract with the Los Angeles Dodgers for a record $700 million. Ohtani, a stellar pitcher _and_ slugger for the California Angels the past six seasons, won the Most Valuable Player award in 2021 and 2023 and finished second in 2022, despite the Angels never being serious contenders. His new deal [eclipses the previous record](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9XuMCzTn2Cp8KP0MD96vtIxZjfmGepPNR_-CG89ZhKxl_x3LqMd3AQvh-NnICeB0Qgeedl_F95shFaCK_HMMmqcA_YjZ4qcgpjICbRcau58U8W28yxHZxd8hKX6zmrQ_Ff572cpuRBHRpIeH7cwH6qSTI25HKXLbhgRvXYdCyM0Q-DGS4eyUcmrr6ZF4BsJhvqEdFZMCrikPP8khynR8QdDyHCWy6622VgE2kIh7KzkVcpAL5BeJwdVsGLkEqpX4r_z5tCG_d0WXCuxdlbe8pdkwmZrj7Xz8Woku5HBMdVI6iG8LU3FWcUJrAogsEcWmtyg%3D%3D), held by his former Angels teammate Mike Trout, at $426 million over 12 years. It's also nearly double what Ohtani was earning in his Angels contract.
## EU Sets World's First Rules on AI
Europe has agreed to the [world's first set of rules](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9XuMCzTn2Cp8KP0MD96vtIxZkT5mtiYrIDY_zMyrDK6F7EVteG0SeMuHPO5fAELPRE_Y2BXC06kaI2xvbPQGR2S7e08IipfYQ-Y9uVGDKK4hHped7y2BzD_krwfoHImjyCwkkH_E27s2ebjIG2N000R6UwTSks4h-0--I5bSJmWqIc3dYS-u9RlOdC8qH9WJZO0cj224FNLgwYn-84Y20621CVsp-gJS6jLs3rLfIHMvtrJei4Vv_woxRFJhB1PO8-G-GfjAxxQPf2a71Hioo6Mo6xtqd90dLKG3sd4XlQ1RP) regulating artificial intelligence, potentially a model for the United States to follow as regulators here grapple with AI's potential consequences. The rules, hashed out by various institutions in the European Union, [target usage of AI against citizens](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=327d3df6f9a04b5e8207e5cd9e0b488f&_e=rI6Hz-QaAurY2XfjnwG9Xh4uG6RPpnqTQvbDpI1wfKyetCrTDJ9naqZuIm_an3hUzFrfZspwu6Txb3_khJZzmOx7ogU3eulQD-1VLRyq6OY04RV7wcYOQGule0aioys8xGSdYpzH9KEpv_NqaP_28qsukNslHBxYZ4OtFRbfn_EDb_to4zmahG4LzH0-yHeod64zofVJ-aiHrv-xJqdo7N1eDuyx7JDaW6l6DyEfRzVTmFhiJo1jueLrHVK-I2gI) in the form of face recognition, scoring of social behavior, manipulative algorithms, and emotion recognition. It also takes aim at the foundational development of new AI systems, but only in a general way, calling for transparency and, in some cases, preliminary model evaluations and testing before new systems can be rolled out.

## Prosecutor Takes Trump to Supreme Court
Special Counsel Jack Smith has taken the extraordinary step of asking the [Supreme Court to rule immediately](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAQRp_GdEZ4MH8FxW3o9rYpkdceL5PYmNjDon37aFOn-ZpPOjo6H7f1ZijQ_vhvIs7s02os0xNXBVKBhHbVlZs9ImBb4ayGBtqpUbqvttl5rZzzYzd10Heqm7z3Xt9R21G1A7YVzdBAq0CBaroOphrt0Pd2nNyosTHaCN2gI065_ky084Y-vNITc21TrMK8MR9FtP8ELAKW67pqu9_t-xSwvNECFgXvUQIWzmc85JFTQXtyytKUryLLeWSMKG06M0tO0qElh_LIWMjhzmSCpBjPnfglv08sTGmvN46hyrM7LgqBSj8I3TyiofCrxn-X-gkAAP__vDNsHA) on whether Donald Trump can claim presidential immunity for his statements and actions as president. Trump's lawyers asked an appeals court to rule on that very issue this week, freezing Smith's case against Trump until a decision was made. Instead, Smith jumped the line with an emergency appeal to the Supreme Court. The Court said Monday afternoon that it would consider the request. If they take the case and rule for Trump, that [would end Smith's prosecution](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAURL8Gd1hwIdgpKNJYq11l2y0tgi_xTbCxAMfav3_yq18zM9I0R-fffbw7irQ-_7oFbQ1pdL7SB0cJXAIHNepmsgERUDVoZSdAXYXUppmtUMF3oQsPIS5mMjpo1aN59AhCS_nAhiwIUBIkSHG5wLVF3xnj--vUaxROO6YFTlRTbl-J1jpjiP_TB3Pr09JEO9e6FaZuDAYGw3Ec7VLW82Mw4Mr3wmBY8ThrS5Eq-XOWfcu4IPdpz_XMOPE3xchfzr95WajOhXtXkB9UZ55W5Hk_FTAYXOa3m4zxz6_fTbbTdlCMVEzHtHgujuI3WP3Z01cAAAD__xutatI). It would still go through the normal appeals process if they refuse to take it up.
## Three Industries Driving U.S. Job Growth
Job growth in the United States has appeared robust this year, but a close analysis shows that it's being driven very narrowly [by three sectors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DHvpCAQBfBPgx0GBhQtKK6x22uvNCwO62xQjEzW229_8ep_85qX_PLy_jzmR6BM--t32NBzKnOITB-cNUgNEsxsm8UnREDToNdOgRmVtn2z-mQGdDGhU6NxmFy_oIpD93zqIXR9sg15UGA0aNCq62BsMbq-j8O4DBZVsEFYhQtxOdt3oZ1XTPlbPni2sWxN9ivzUYX5JWASMF3X1Ya_VOrdCphuW8Ck4Q4tYHqXZ5UnHuVkWTkwVaZY5Yoh8xrDifJ14_uGO8u11IM4ZOJvc_rluChnqr0TVr22QPn_BP75kX8BAAD__wwwY0E): Health care, government employment, and hospitality. The economy added nearly 200,000 jobs in November alone, but 83% came from those three sectors, plus 28,000 manufacturing jobs, mainly striking autoworkers returning to work. Only 5,000 jobs were in other sectors. Retail actually[ lost 38,000 jobs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAURb8GOxx4gLoFRRq7TZvSQXiubEAcYHX27zMmbZrbnObc83Wf7sYHvz0-TURdlzQZW_2BEwfKgYKYZOP0gggoGtS8ZyBujMuuWbV0nZpdr5yae-FwUKi6ZbELqnkWHFzjNTAQHDhwphTcWrR919nh5gaJzEhDJEPna8rtM_mtrriEdzowtzbFJui11r0Q8UFgJDCe59lmfFXM5eIExmjyN9ZCYHz9DX2mmT5yOutKjbUYMJuKhW7pwDhjpq8N4x7SO-JW6cWoy2kvVPT0Ur0us4HA2GTt9tOH4EvXE8ke0fjwa1X_j_QTAAD__66Cacw), and other industries were flat or down as well. I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signatures is Needed: Tell the Department of Interior to stop auctioning off our public lands
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2190435?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Protect 6,510 acres of public lands from greedy fossil fuel companies!** Our public lands are precious. Some contain **stunning geologic structures** : archways, canyons, and dramatic mountain peaks. Some are home to **unique and endangered wildlife** – from top predators like grizzly bears and gray wolves to majestic birds such as the greater sage-grouse. Communities across the country get their drinking water from public lands. In short, public lands, their inhabitants, and all who rely on their resources should be protected – _**not sold to the highest fossil fuel bidder!**_ The Department of Interior is planning to lease **THOUSANDS of acres** of public lands to companies who will drill, frack, and mine away in North Dakota. Public lands will be destroyed so a greedy executive can line their pockets. The DOI is considering public opinion, but **the comment period for this lease sale ends in just a FEW DAYS!** [_**Please, Friend, tell the Department of Interior to PROTECT our public lands from greedy companies and STOP fossil fuel lease sales! >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2190436?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2190437?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Fossil fuel drilling POISONS the air with toxic pollution. The consequences impact nearby communities and wildlife. In some cases, fracking can even contaminate drinking water with **radioactive waste!** Air pollution causes major problems too. People exposed can suffer from **respiratory illnesses, splitting headaches, nausea,** and more.
Fossil fuel companies aren’t oblivious to these consequences – they’re aware of the effects of their industry. That doesn’t stop them from polluting if profits are involved.
The Department of Interior knows the impacts too – but **unless they hear from environmentalists like you, these lease sales in North Dakota could move forward anyway![_Take just 30 seconds to help SAVE public lands from fossil fuels! Sign now!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2190438?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfip4ehd4qscpo1g1bdhh00kl6i1f8vjdl16iico_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g64oj1cth2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsbrqft58pj0ovujmcvk5e4oem148kp7o0vflcro_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g64oj1cth2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zkm6mc0so57m6k6geqg0ags4t1ghetgoml5o4q8g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g64oj1cth2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686438%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IBgNROA4oNmuY8CGCgg5UQ&sysid=1)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God’s Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686438%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IBgNROA4oNmuY8CGCgg5UQ&sysid=1)
---
| | We’re offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here’s an outline of what we’ll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we’ll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we’ll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we’ll gain wisdom from Solomon’s reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we’ll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c686439%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ot603eX7T0OMSaAtDU%2fSew&sysid=1).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I’m very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

American Update

body:

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

My team and I are committed to championing conservative solutions that fortify our nation's foundations -- faith, liberty, community, and life. We're boldly standing up for pro-life principles and leading the charge for the significant improvement of our education system, with special emphasis on the teaching of true American history. [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5m4o09d38lutkvkba2q5jtf9265lpjsj9mbt9ig_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g6ao76c9h2bs) Although our resolve is unwavering, and our mission is clear, I need your help to refine our strategies and improve our efforts. Your invaluable perspective plays a critical role in shaping the future of our efforts.

I have prepared a brief survey that seeks to understand your views better. The survey focuses on the following key areas:

* Our effectiveness in promoting and preserving conservative values.
* The impact of our 'Little Patriots' educational program.
* Our pro-life advocacy efforts.

You can start the survey here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/cye-2023](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhgh3s2h67jdbldq1j1pthk803fr4d57ptdongko_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g6ao76c9h2bs).

Your response will not only provide critical feedback but will also help me shape our future initiatives. I invite you to share your thoughts with me today. Your voice matters, and together, we can continue on our quest to preserve and promote the conservative values that make our nation great!

I sincerely appreciate your time, input, and unwavering support!

Best Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6kf5onnm6g318q5873muhdnqie57fhgkn4pctbg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g6aoj7cdh2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1t4e7372cajdt1ofb0lg7fbm7r45gh715mgmo50_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g6aoj7cdh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znmg80min05i398unt43sq94p2ue5ak5lcv8r3lo_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g6aoj7cdh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

body:
🇺🇸 The people of Nebraska are RISING! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12667072?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=76813f3dca&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

Last night I had the privilege to be the featured speaker at the Buffalo County Republican Party meeting. I love to travel and enjoyed the drive to Kearney making my way to where they have their meetings - Kearney Public Library. As I shook hands with new friends and connected in with Joe Maul and Sue Greenwald, (Chair and Secretary), I took a pause to marvel at the work of the county. 60 members were in attendance and in that room you could feel a small sense of community...a sense of belonging. Buffalo GOP and their efforts were actively engaged in defending the 2nd Amendment just a few weeks ago as the Kearney City Council had imposed a resolution (No. 2023-149) that would infringe upon that right. By having an organized and growing County Party they mobilized the voices of the people, used the resources of coalition groups, and connected with the NEGOP to prepare for a November 28th meeting of the City Council. Because of their efforts and that of The People, the unconstitutional resolution creating Gun-Free Zones was rescinded on a 3-2 vote.

Back at their meeting, the agenda was simple and purposeful. Agenda approval, minutes approval, and then a heart-warming fundraising update (the Buffalo County GOP spent the last 45 days raising money to help the STATE party). **They collectively raised over $6000** to help fund the NEGOP. It was important to me to be there last night because I firmly believe in showing appreciation and gratitude with a handshake. I shook as many hands as I could last night.

The next part of their meeting is what makes being the Chairman fulfilling. Joe detailed the plan for the Central Committee development and how it will be handled at their County Convention next year. Sue spoke about preparing for delegate signups and the County Convention. The Wilkinson's discussed the precinct Neighborhood Captains program. Lastly, a member who attends every Kearney School Board meeting gave a report as to what she saw last night at the school board meeting before she came to the GOP meeting. She indicated that a student in high school shared a screenshot of a health class test that asked a test question about gender fluidity and a multiple choice defining. This is how you proactively build a party!

I am beyond measure proud of Buffalo County GOP. They are creating **stability** within their organization. They are actively fulfilling the objectives of the party by doing maintenance of the government of, by, and for the people AND furthering their principles within the community. And this effort will continue to grow and grow as more Buffalo Republicans will join the efforts. Well done, Buffalo County.

I see this growth and **stability** EVERYWHERE in Nebraska now. Dixon County, Seward County, Gage County, York County, Sarpy County, Saline County, Madison, Keith, Hall, and on and on...and the growth and **stability** is coming FROM the people. From leaders of the party, who CHOOSE to grow and build their counties because the people matter and connecting people to our values matters. Who choose to sacrifice their time to become better every day and engage more volunteers to make more engagement opportunities. From Chairs and Secretaries, committeemen and women, elected officials to candidates SEE the reality of what strong, healthy County Parties can do.

This is happening NATIONWIDE! One precinct, one town, one county, one district, one state at a time. Using our values to create unity, but proactively building the **STABILITY** that is necessary for all organizations to thrive. And the people will come. I truly believe that God has a hand in all things, all things...and he has a hand on the people of this party. He provides the courage and fortitude needed in the darkness. He prepares us mentally and spiritually for a battle against the enemies of HIS people and this great nation.

These next 3-4 months there will be a storm of engagement of, by and for the Republican Party of Nebraska. We are going **ALL-IN** on local campaigns and local elected positions such as school boards, city council, county seats, NRD's, power boards.

In 2024, we are going **ALL-IN** on** ** the VALUES of Education, **ALL-IN** on Election Accountability and Voter Verification, **ALL-IN** on Winner-Take-All, **ALL-IN** on Tax Reform, **ALL-IN** on Protecting Human Rights. The groundwork has been completed and in 2024 it will all come down to a choice by EVERY Republican. This will come to fruition in our Legislative Plan and through the voices of the people who will expect the very most from their elected representatives.

Whatever you do...in 2024...don't think that you can't make a difference. You, and your time and talents, are the difference **MAKERS**.

The Values of the Republican Party resonate with Nebraskans. We just have to reach out to as many as we can and 2024 is a victory for Conservative Principles. 2024 is a victory we can all share in. We must be articulate and bold in standing firm on these belief's. **Americans are thirsting for people of courage, people of honesty and truth...they are hungry for leaders to say what they are going to do...AND...then DO what they say!**

Three weeks ago I spoke at a Government class at Lincoln East and had an amazing engagement with the young folks. We are missing an opportunity if we do not connect NOW with teenagers and young adults. This class was so respectful and very much aware of the world. We should give them more credit and do our absolute best to reflect common sense and conservative values to this generation...because deep down...I believe the next generation is soul searching and they will need a path shown that is FILLED with His word. Let's be THEIR light!

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---

| –Chairman Underwood
