clean_body: 🇺🇸 The people of Nebraska are RISING! | | | | | | | Good Morning Republicans, Last night I had the privilege to be the featured speaker at the Buffalo County Republican Party meeting. I love to travel and enjoyed the drive to Kearney making my way to where they have their meetings - Kearney Public Library. As I shook hands with new friends and connected in with Joe Maul and Sue Greenwald, (Chair and Secretary), I took a pause to marvel at the work of the county. 60 members were in attendance and in that room you could feel a small sense of community...a sense of belonging. Buffalo GOP and their efforts were actively engaged in defending the 2nd Amendment just a few weeks ago as the Kearney City Council had imposed a resolution (No. 2023-149) that would infringe upon that right. By having an organized and growing County Party they mobilized the voices of the people, used the resources of coalition groups, and connected with the NEGOP to prepare for a November 28th meeting of the City Council. Because of their efforts and that of The People, the unconstitutional resolution creating Gun-Free Zones was rescinded on a 3-2 vote. Back at their meeting, the agenda was simple and purposeful. Agenda approval, minutes approval, and then a heart-warming fundraising update (the Buffalo County GOP spent the last 45 days raising money to help the STATE party). They collectively raised over $6000 to help fund the NEGOP. It was important to me to be there last night because I firmly believe in showing appreciation and gratitude with a handshake. I shook as many hands as I could last night. The next part of their meeting is what makes being the Chairman fulfilling. Joe detailed the plan for the Central Committee development and how it will be handled at their County Convention next year. Sue spoke about preparing for delegate signups and the County Convention. The Wilkinson's discussed the precinct Neighborhood Captains program. Lastly, a member who attends every Kearney School Board meeting gave a report as to what she saw last night at the school board meeting before she came to the GOP meeting. She indicated that a student in high school shared a screenshot of a health class test that asked a test question about gender fluidity and a multiple choice defining. This is how you proactively build a party! I am beyond measure proud of Buffalo County GOP. They are creating stability within their organization. They are actively fulfilling the objectives of the party by doing maintenance of the government of, by, and for the people AND furthering their principles within the community. And this effort will continue to grow and grow as more Buffalo Republicans will join the efforts. Well done, Buffalo County. I see this growth and stability EVERYWHERE in Nebraska now. Dixon County, Seward County, Gage County, York County, Sarpy County, Saline County, Madison, Keith, Hall, and on and on...and the growth and stability is coming FROM the people. From leaders of the party, who CHOOSE to grow and build their counties because the people matter and connecting people to our values matters. Who choose to sacrifice their time to become better every day and engage more volunteers to make more engagement opportunities. From Chairs and Secretaries, committeemen and women, elected officials to candidates SEE the reality of what strong, healthy County Parties can do. This is happening NATIONWIDE! One precinct, one town, one county, one district, one state at a time. Using our values to create unity, but proactively building the STABILITY that is necessary for all organizations to thrive. And the people will come. I truly believe that God has a hand in all things, all things...and he has a hand on the people of this party. He provides the courage and fortitude needed in the darkness. He prepares us mentally and spiritually for a battle against the enemies of HIS people and this great nation. These next 3-4 months there will be a storm of engagement of, by and for the Republican Party of Nebraska. We are going ALL-IN on local campaigns and local elected positions such as school boards, city council, county seats, NRD's, power boards. In 2024, we are going ALL-IN on the VALUES of Education, ALL-IN on Election Accountability and Voter Verification, ALL-IN on Winner-Take-All, ALL-IN on Tax Reform, ALL-IN on Protecting Human Rights. The groundwork has been completed and in 2024 it will all come down to a choice by EVERY Republican. This will come to fruition in our Legislative Plan and through the voices of the people who will expect the very most from their elected representatives. Whatever you do...in 2024...don't think that you can't make a difference. You, and your time and talents, are the difference MAKERS. The Values of the Republican Party resonate with Nebraskans. We just have to reach out to as many as we can and 2024 is a victory for Conservative Principles. 2024 is a victory we can all share in. We must be articulate and bold in standing firm on these belief's. Americans are thirsting for people of courage, people of honesty and truth...they are hungry for leaders to say what they are going to do...AND...then DO what they say! Three weeks ago I spoke at a Government class at Lincoln East and had an amazing engagement with the young folks. We are missing an opportunity if we do not connect NOW with teenagers and young adults. This class was so respectful and very much aware of the world. We should give them more credit and do our absolute best to reflect common sense and conservative values to this generation...because deep down...I believe the next generation is soul searching and they will need a path shown that is FILLED with His word. Let's be THEIR light! The truth shall set us free. With much blessings, | | –Chairman Underwood | | County & Candidate Spotlight | {"County & Candidate Spotlight" is an informational component of this newsletter ONLY in an effort to expand Republican relationships to our membership. ____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God’s Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

Bob

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

My team and I are committed to championing conservative solutions that fortify our nation's foundations -- faith, liberty, community, and life. We're boldly standing up for pro-life principles and leading the charge for the significant improvement of our education system, with special emphasis on the teaching of true American history. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdc36be4d7kn3ivb5kffkbgkj1k222gojmvhebu0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g69ob4cph2bs) Although our resolve is unwavering, and our mission is clear, I need your help to refine our strategies and improve our efforts. Your invaluable perspective plays a critical role in shaping the future of our efforts.

I have prepared a brief survey that seeks to understand your views better. The survey focuses on the following key areas:

* Our effectiveness in promoting and preserving conservative values.
* The impact of our 'Little Patriots' educational program.
* Our pro-life advocacy efforts.

You can start the survey here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/cye-2023](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5ae0bnoe9m6rmvjjog48s6fps534o5knabu1r68_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5g69ob4cph2bs).

Your response will not only provide critical feedback but will also help me shape our future initiatives. I invite you to share your thoughts with me today. Your voice matters, and together, we can continue on our quest to preserve and promote the conservative values that make our nation great!

I sincerely appreciate your time, input, and unwavering support!

Best Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson

Dear Friend,
That wasn’t a typo–I am excited to share with you that my campaign has teamed up with Civox, a new political AI company to introduce this groundbreaking new technology into our efforts. We are the first campaign to ever deploy a tool like this!
You can read all about our launch of this new tool in POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/12/12/democratic-campaign-ai-caller-00131180] , Forbes [https://www.forbes.com/sites/rashishrivastava/2023/12/12/this-congressional-candidate-is-using-ai-to-have-conversations-with-thousands-of-voters/?sh=53e4ae5610f7] , and Reuters [https://www.reuters.com/technology/meet-ashley-worlds-first-ai-powered-political-campaign-caller-2023-12-12/] .
As a Harrisburg PA City Council member for over a decade, I’ve run my share of campaigns. In each of them, I’ve been able to knock on just about every door in my district and talk to almost every one of my potential voters. This enabled me to hear directly from those I would be representing and allowed me to better serve them once elected.

subject: These are hotbeds of anti-Americanism
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
We need to be holding higher education institutions accountable for the fraud they're perpetuating on the public. The American people are waking up to the insanity—and we're all appalled.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [ ](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3384a0a212432289428cb01c51a35c24ded4c8932a956ad22ba0485d6b67de9b7da3195c746906d727657cfca29a586bc4a92addb8bc61c1)
---

Friend, If you've tuned in to the news lately, you've seen something horrifying take place. The presidents of liberal institutions have shoved so much indoctrination into their curricula that they're allowing their campuses to become hotbeds for anti-Americanism and antisemitism. _And they're refusing to condemn the terror-ridden protests that have spread like a disease across their schools._ **DO YOU AGREE THAT THE PRESIDENTS OF THESE SCHOOLS SHOULD BE HELD ACCOUNTABLE AND FIRED FOR THEIR APPALLING LEADERSHIP?**
---
| | [RESPOND HERE](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3384a0a212432289428cb01c51a35c24ded4c8932a956ad22ba0485d6b67de9b7da3195c746906d727657cfca29a586bc4a92addb8bc61c1)
---
The presidents of these institutions are encouraging, enabling, and _defending_ this toxic behavior. They're declaring that it's okay to call for the genocide of Jews - and citing "free speech" as the justification - yet they're firing their own staff members for taking normal positions on conservative issues. Where are the morals? How can they sit in front of Congress and defend these atrocities? And then keep their jobs? **_While some people get to act as they please in the name of "free speech," others are canceled for every opinion that doesn't align with a radical ideology. This level of mob-mentality has reached all-time highs and it's THREATENING to this country._** It's time to extinguish the rot and sickness that has been festering in these classrooms. That starts with cleaning house of all the corrupt, confused, and deranged heads of higher institutions. I need to know if you're with me, friend.
---
| | [LET ME KNOW WHERE YOU STAND](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=3384a0a212432289428cb01c51a35c24ded4c8932a956ad22ba0485d6b67de9b7da3195c746906d727657cfca29a586bc4a92addb8bc61c1)
---

Yours In Freedom,

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

| | Peter, With Communists country, you could be taken with no warning and never seen again.

That’s what happened to both of my grandfathers. The Viet Congs took them in the middle of the night and ripped them from their families. _One was never seen again._

When it was apparent Saigon was about to fall, my parents knew they couldn’t stay. When I was just four years old, we were lucky enough to escape to the land of opportunity: the United States of America.

Once we got to America, I had opportunities I couldn’t have even dreamed of. My family focused on education, and with hard work and dedication, I was able to learn English and earn a prestigious spot at the U.S. Naval Academy.

I fell in love with America, and I knew I had to protect the freedom that I owed my life to. I served for more than 25 years as a U.S. Navy Captain, and my service took me to some of the most dangerous places in the world like Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia.

**After traveling the world with the Navy, I can say with 100% certainty that there is no place like America. But now, the fibers of our country are in jeopardy.**

**[I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I love this country too much to let it fall. And if you love America too, I need you to act now. **John Teichert Launches ‘Veterans for Teichert Coalition’**
**BALTIMORE, Md.** – This past week, retired Brigadier General John Teichert, candidate for U.S. Senate launched the ‘Veterans for Teichert’ coalition – the first coalition group of the campaign cycle!
The coalition is composed of two dozen veterans who served in the U.S. Military. They are eager for a real leader in Washington who understands their service, sacrifice, and fears as they see weakness abroad and ineffectiveness at home. These veterans firmly believe that General Teichert is the champion they have been waiting for.
**"It is about time that a strong leader gets elected to serve in the U.S.Senate from Maryland** ,” Dale Hall, Chairman of the Veterans for Teichert Coalition said in a statement. **“Throughout my career in the USMC, I witnessed what strong, selfless leadership looks like and how it can motivate and inspire a team. The first time I spoke with General Teichert I was impressed by his energy, passion and integrity. That’s why I am joining General Teichert and offering to lead our Veterans for Teichert Coalition. We're orchestrating a movement—a Veterans Coalition that's not just a campaign but a growing group of servicemen and women who are joining with General Teichert to advance leadership and integrity, not politics as usual in DC.”**
In launching the coalition, Teichert sat down with eight veterans in person and a handful online for a coalition roundtable to discuss the issues that concern them the most heading into 2024.
The Veterans for John Teichert Coalition follows growing support for John Teichert’s candidacy for the U.S. Senate out of Maryland. As the election approaches, Teichert remains focused on representing the interests and issues of Marylanders across the state by promoting his compelling message of leadership, not politics.

> _After decades of Republican-led culture wars, the national Democratic Party struggles in states like Missouri. But in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can outrun the party. And they can defeat divisive and corrupt opponents._
> _That’s the dynamic we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as Democrat Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Republican Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — except people actually liked my opponent. (Roy Blunt never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there.)_
> _Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Kunce, a Marine veteran and leading antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party._
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE: CHIP IN →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39906?refcode=em20231212-4370&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4370%2E614464%2EOeh_pM)**

> _In Missouri, [Hawley has] become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood. From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans._
> _Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen._
> _Multiple public polls — including one from Morning Consult released last month — show Hawley has the lowest approval of any Republican senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the “worst mistake I ever made.”_
> _Donald Trump is well aware Hawley’s seat is in danger. “So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas,” he posted Sunday on his vanity social media site Truth Social. “Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**From his recent polling to his crumbling support base, we have never had a better opportunity to defeat Josh Hawley and elect a real warrior for working people to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.**

# [Tell the Supreme Court: Trump should have no immunity from prosecution for crimes he committed while in office!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta437128d-ae06-4798-8b04-79633888530d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Special counsel Jack Smith has asked the Supreme Court to fast-track a decision on whether Trump has immunity from criminal prosecution for the crimes he committed while he was president. Smith is asking this so he can keep Trump’s trial on schedule, which is set to start in March. Trump’s claim that he has full immunity for any crime committed is absurd and wildly dangerous, and we need the Supreme Court to reject his assertion ASAP. He attempted a coup and tried to overthrow our democracy – it’s time to throw the book at him, not give him a “Get out of jail” card! Friend,

What University campuses are exploding with a disturbing spectacle: students gathering _not in the name of peace_ but to celebrate the heinous acts of violence and terror perpetrated by Hamas against Israelis.

Numerous law students from top schools signed letters explicitly saying that Israelis deserved to be killed.

Even when prestigious law firms rescinded offers from law students at NYU, Harvard, and Columbia, certain segments of the academic community still endorsed these demonstrations, and administrators failed to condemn these acts unequivocally, appealing to these students' right to express their opinions.

**American universities are championing terror in the name of free speech.**

I'm Tahmineh Dehbozorgi, a speaker with the Dissident Project. As a dissident from the Islamic Republic of Iran and a student at George Washington University, I recognize this trend in universities to silence anyone who would speak out against authoritarian regimes.

Dissident Project speakers travel to high schools around the country to warn the next generation about the dangers of socialism and authoritarianism. You can also find us speaking out against authoritarianism on major media outlets like Fox News.

This time of year can be tough for a campaign’s fundraising efforts. **While you’re likely going to holiday parties, doing some last-minute shopping, or preparing to travel, your attention is elsewhere (as it should be!).** But the pressure on campaigns to fundraise doesn’t go away. Especially for a candidate like Sarah. Not only is it the last end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the year. But a _looooot_ of eyes are on Sarah and this race. There are some who dismiss Sarah’s remarkable accomplishments delivering for Delawareans in the state Senate. They say we’re not ready for a candidate like Sarah. And on the other hand, some think that this race is already over. **We know three things:**
* There are _no guarantees_ in politics.
* What armchair quarterbacks say won’t determine the outcome of this race.

It’s been nearly a week since the presidents of Harvard, the University of Pennsylvania, and MIT- under oath in front of Congress - declined to say that hateful rhetoric on their campuses, including calling for the genocide of Jews, constituted hate speech according to their school’s code of conduct.

_**My opponent, Montana Democrat Jon Tester, has said nothing.**_

I want to know your stance on this, Peter. Please drop what you’re doing and spend 30 seconds answering a few questions on my mind over the last couple of days.

The testimony by all three university heads was _**pathetic**_. The testimony each of the three women who sat in front of Congress yesterday gave was not only dehumanizing toward the Jewish people, but _**it also sent a clear message to the enemies of Israel in America that their hate toward Jews is acceptable on college campuses across our country**_.

Meanwhile, over on Twitter, Jon Tester wasn’t posting about the importance of defending Israel or condemning hate speech against Jewish Americans - **he was posting about butchering meat.**

As a former Navy SEAL and current U.S. Senate candidate, defending America’s right to exist, our freedom, and the values that we stand for are always at the forefront of everything I do in life. We need folks in the United States Senate who aren’t afraid to ask tough questions, defend our democratic allies abroad, _**and, more importantly, stand up for what is right.**_

The presidents of Harvard, MIT, and UPenn should lose their jobs for their failure to condemn Jewish hate, and Jon Tester should be ashamed of himself for having nothing to say about Jewish genocide.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---

When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support | | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. body:
| To make Eve’s birthday extra special, I would love to collect signatures and kind words from folks like you.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4732%2E5257348%2EBNMAeT)
Derek — I have a special request for you today:
[**Will you sign the birthday card for my wife Eve? You can add your name and a short note if you want, too:**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202312-Eve-birthday-card.SPq7gd&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231212_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4732%2E5257348%2EBNMAeT)
[SIGN THE CARD](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202312-Eve-birthday-card.SPq7gd&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231212_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4732%2E5257348%2EBNMAeT)
---
It’s no exaggeration to say that I would not be here, running for U.S. Senate, serving in Congress, defending our democracy every day, without Eve’s support.
I first met Eve playing tennis in Playa del Rey, where a friend with an odd sense of humor set us up to play — Adam vs. Eve. She impressed me with her sense of humor, intellect, beauty, and wicked double backhand. She clobbered me.
And when I asked her out, I think Eve only said yes because she let her curiosity get the best of her — going out on a date with someone named Adam.
We’ve been together ever since — and she has been my rock through the good times and the hard times. Here we are, back in the day:
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202312-Eve-birthday-card.SPq7gd&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231212_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=4732%2E5257348%2EBNMAeT)
From life’s highs, like the birth of our two children, to the lows, like the endless stream of threats from the MAGA crowd, Eve has supported me.
She stood by me through all the attacks — and the attacks have only grown more fierce since I served as lead impeachment manager in Donald Trump’s first trial.
Eve has even sent a few emails to you because it’s important to me that you hear from her about this campaign — she knows me best.
**Eve is an amazing wife, mother, confidant, friend, and partner, and I’m so lucky to be her husband.**
[**To make this birthday extra special, I would love to collect signatures and kind words from folks like you. Will you add your name to her birthday card, Derek? It would mean so much to me.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202312-Eve-birthday-card.SPq7gd&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231212_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=4732%2E5257348%2EBNMAeT)
[SIGN THE CARD](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202312-Eve-birthday-card.SPq7gd&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231212_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=8&akid=4732%2E5257348%2EBNMAeT)
---
I’m looking forward to sharing the card with her later today. Thanks for signing, and for letting me sing Eve’s praises (and sing happy birthday to her later, too!).
— Adam

| Hi there, Last month, I joined my friend, Congresswoman Hillary Scholten, in West Michigan to lead an announcement of her endorsement of my campaign. This endorsement, in particular, means a lot to me. Ever since Hillary flipped her seat in 2022, it has been wonderful to see her fight on behalf of West Michiganders and help pave the Democratic infrastructure in the fast-growing (and traditionally Republican) part of the state.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75032448/443402413/276784023?refcode=BLU_EM_HSC_2023-12-12_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWVlMmY2NC0wYzk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XeaHT3HvZOVRx2rwS6YEoaxCJ0r2LAaKWPqJwPR-JVI=)
I am thankful for Hillary’s endorsement, and I am writing with the hope that I can earn your support as well. Let me get you caught up on where things currently stand in this Senate race. Since the great Senator Debbie Stabenow announced that she was retiring, things have really heated up in Michigan: CNN named us one of the 10 Senate seats most likely to flip in 2024, and top political insiders are saying that Michigan is the state _**most likely to decide the presidential election. **_ And over the last two months, we’ve seen three serious Republican candidates enter the race: former Congressman Mike Rogers, former Detroit Police Chief James Craig, and former Grand Rapids Congressman Peter Meijer, who represented this area before Hillary. All three have unfortunately done the predictable thing and immediately started saying whatever they can to appeal to the most extreme parts of the GOP in order to win. But the Senate majority isn’t the only thing on the line in 2024. Experts are already saying that Hillary’s district in West Michigan remains a battleground in the fight for the House majority, and Republican groups are already spending big in their efforts to unseat Hillary. And, as I alluded to, West Michigan has really become a political powerhouse in the state, making success there instrumental in my efforts to win statewide. All of the above is why I would love to earn your support on behalf of my and Hillary’s campaigns. # **_Why Only Counties?_**
## **Because all politics is local!**
The next most frequent question I am getting is: Why is Caucus Room restricting communication and groups to Members from a single county? The answer: Local is all that matters.None of the frustrations we experience as conservatives can be addressed at the state or national level. All change is local. All elections are local. All culture is local. I live in Jefferson County Colorado. Jefferson County Colorado used to be a reliably conservative county. Over the past 10 years it has become a left leaning county. Why does that matter? We are now represented by Democrats in the Colorado house/senate/governor and US House. Because Jefferson county has shifted left, the US Senate has two Democrat senators from Colorado. If we could find a way to move Jefferson County voters a little to the right, we could change the way our children are taught, how our county is managed, and shift the balance of power in the State and in the Country. But that will require focus, resources and effort at the county level.Jefferson County Colorado is not the only county in the country experiencing the same shifts. Some have shifted left recently; some decades ago; and some not yet. But the strategy is the same. We must effectively organize our neighbors and neighborhoods either to recapture lost territory or to protect what we have. The more conservatives are distracted by what is happening elsewhere, the less time, energy and resources we will have to influence our neighbors to be more open to and resonate with conservative values. It is not that complicated. All politics is local. The only way to move the country is for enough of us to move our own individual counties.
### Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
### John Coors

subject: My Journey, My Story, My Vision
body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
| |
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~ "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!>>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~ "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~ "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/eywcL5cgogjCkyG1WIrr2A~~/AARclAA~~)
---
Nikki Haley

| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/B8dX2Grbpt1XrcXT9BgpyA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnWzaOP4RtAWh0dHBzOi8vc2VjdXJlLndpbnJlZC5jb20vdGVhbS1zdGFuZC1mb3ItYW1lcmljYS93aHktaW0tcnVubmluZy1mb290ZXItdHY_ "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/B8dX2Grbpt1XrcXT9BgpyA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnWzaOP4RtAWh0dHBzOi8vc2VjdXJlLndpbnJlZC5jb20vdGVhbS1zdGFuZC1mb3ItYW1lcmljYS93aHktaW0tcnVubmluZy1mb290ZXItdHY_ "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

Fellow Conservative,

Recently, I received an email from **former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy who is running for the U.S. Senate in Montana**. It moved me so much that I am forwarding it to you today. Please do me a personal favor and take a few minutes to read it - _**it’s compelling.**_

Best Regards,
Kellyanne Conway

\--------------------------------------------
**From:** Tim Sheehy
**Date:** Thursday, December 7, 2023 at 3:30 PM
**To:** Kellyanne Conway
**Subject:** The day 13 Americans were vaporized in Kabul

Kellyanne,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYfP4xWX0B_gAJkg6M1n9lIsoR82APPPJyayR0EnsNPOxD-TgH7W0uQg7S_45lD-4hLpbIBaY04EPqrmyBMO41UTbS3SFqULhCBWsU2PTrFV_PMBYo-frfMbH0VofRDaMw_NBKby7SaWW1eGo3ySRyCc%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYR8FWU9cC65qMRPI3ukPEd9sY_gqFinyMCxoBiQUjPYnXY84f_yAXATDmICCPzu_VMxM7iK8ud5uCVicBU-BfIsOE9caDa_IASMMcgb1hZugQ5xSzHGprTL7UgbCdt1IRe89-oCNlfPtgEVX_NMcALA%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5SeY6OIJKGNtdVfFD-IQ59QipNhPoHulsaVs0OSBu7DryYP5XrJ0bD3S6mxzrV5ft8u9X-HVViFrZU6-6SXKdQiu-xbV1-lEwCdVx8VcUBGTxEGxGbnHVRfvO8BLiIC08k9R5yRQl6_tV_AtidEWJNppWMZbYuiQFIHrITEXw34BVrG2AdX0QwUEyZ3nclrTICgqAea4zKatt_-5K2W70nEclP1COf2ameMx54ibbi2IjtKrjGFKpWwYYcNMOJDQIgsXdNLfUfSy-LIlwx1PnKyMdyiwfKcBHLloYRvvSYGq1LF1j1JhZX7XkmJoQwix86KxlvYuPOfZDwLJi8PMFANjioNRGgHIwCAQczBrTUok%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYdpQ0JpecEFzRcAno41dymQX8CVYEEuY9rQTqR9MY8YpcWf_zH1fLwPYS1Bbm_I2T_RVsGmcwv2AP87EAoqsMVZ1B6hQuJKBkTIuUi5p7PQwKKaA6FsMc_iCnJYcIqG0XRDeynd7yTMTNO3uJDJWBRc%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYUaGEnr81UpbrrpQbdoCqriKlMdfbSnXWsekqGtBozj44k9Kgn9T0JyaOMPqLo1fm-gPJ8CXwTNoe-5NXqiPNHPm2S_CTPJKkSOXYaKcn_T4ZzqtKk3uQhvrR5fkRiqfa9XzWCUN9cc9OoUcn7Mz9J4%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYULf5ljxM5wi8i549PRuBPQnW2w3y4z8mXOxvUcYAk-NOyfuvFhTIettwGOnrK00kcQGpuEuPLsScCKLxezQH1YFFTVNDA8KnJKE-c0jKS-T7pw123JnHTspADDOkv7hlIdbvjCvF1ebxdUl1oPRMKU%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYeqQdDLPpAOvKgFR1o46ELBfpvBZ1GbkjhOumHO76BH-y9aP61NVRstDgE_AkojiWlW8tW0GDxBkisvxhAT72IVgviSvaimGZVraw9qsGfjwvUc4w1xWyHrPdXvMuKBba62kqbdroUoNfSEPsWtfmto%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYehUJvAqKzN2yuRsPFKoWh--Fav0p_WXVt9r0WMm504nAqgZyOFDad4OEgEyY6vFSPseHU3OcXbbkF7AZ68CtjcoE21SXXn1a4LjflidA9Ba8NJTa_jbz3vqiCVNyOOWSAzQCbDlzUD6u3T7mrx5BdU%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Kellyanne \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

[**HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT
ELECT A FIGHTER TO THE U.S. SENATE->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=efd698ccf0194d6fa18bee097a377eb9&_e=nKHWiTkMoOg7Mr8iaRxMJSRtGLgvomOQYOFDzoJTiV_0XLquuOPqbOowAhVx0Wy5psZYmuB4Vx_BxPa0gODVxSCSDPw5k0ks5LSygaO4M6GcKm41EsiOHZuIcdxHABR6TkZ7me0KhULlvpQ_yVOBHR9XGkPH2ZxGJ7QIbXn_xSVT1FZxEN6UKStM-Qpuvv5XdoPMxSAWLrDv-Tm-k7k4WhY8wGUh3bhMuzOsDpQucps0o6yShb_cgEJd-KlCxVZiNTOcqmFDh_PraWm37_LQYRAI2SV7Em11gLMOT9wcS_CirYlhZ-DCXsRf37VYRGVKxkvLxzIlLSP-r0VOENA2QJZbWWmwvohM090s97zB7R7n5r6A0852yxJon3zZn92Ni8eceFs4jklL8-m2QGMulVKuLzwXeb64afsGJSopRGI%3D)

For America's Future,

Tim Sheehy

clean_body: "Please take a moment to read about this exceptional candidate I’m supporting " | | Fellow Conservative, Recently, I received an email from former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy who is running for the U.S. Senate in Montana. It moved me so much that I am forwarding it to you today. Please do me a personal favor and take a few minutes to read it - it’s compelling. Best Regards, Kellyanne Conway \-------------------------------------------- From: Tim Sheehy Date: Thursday, December 7, 2023 at 3:30 PM To: Kellyanne Conway Subject: The day 13 Americans were vaporized in Kabul Kellyanne, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Kellyanne \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

body:
Our campaign has been gaining incredible momentum, fueled by the dedication of passionate supporters like you. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/alfonsoforcongress.com/contribute-to-the-future-of-west-michigan-9610536?e=16d812e81c)
---

Hope this email finds you well. We're reaching out to you today because we believe in a future where our voices matter, where the working class is truly represented, and where we build bridges toward progress. In the spirit of these ideals, we're excited to share an opportunity for you to make a difference and take the fight for change directly to the heart of our political landscape.
Our campaign is gaining momentum, and we need your support to take it to the next level. Here's how you can be a crucial part of this movement:
1. Sign Our Petition:We're on a mission to bring real change to our community, and it starts with getting our candidate on the ballot. Your signature can make a significant impact. Join us in advocating for a working-class candidate who understands your concerns and is committed to bridging the gap between citizens and their government.

|
---
|
---
2\. Help Us Take the Fight to Bill Huizenga:The time has come to challenge the status quo and advocate for a representative who truly understands the needs of the working class. Together, we can take the fight to Bill Huizenga and build a future that works for all of us. Your contribution, whether big or small, can make a meaningful difference in this campaign.
| [JOIN OUR MOVEMENT: DONATE TODAY](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=cbeba8d022&e=16d812e81c)
---
|
---
3. Join us on December 18th, 2023, for a groundbreaking fundraiser featuring special guest Fred Wellman, Former Executive at The Lincoln Project and current host of the On Democracy Podcast on MeidasTouch Media. This is a unique opportunity to engage in insightful discussions about the future of our democracy and support our campaign to bridge the gap and champion a working-class future. Secure your spot by RSVPing to [info@alfonsoforcongress.com](mailto:info@alfonsoforcongress.com) – together, let's pave the way for positive change.

|
---
4\. Be a Part of Building Toward the Future:Our vision is to build a future that is inclusive, fair, and focused on the needs of the many, not the few. By supporting our campaign, you are investing in a future where working-class values are at the forefront of decision-making. Join us in building toward a better tomorrow.
| [JOIN OUR MOVEMENT: SIGN-UP TO VOLUNTEER](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=f47acf8773&e=16d812e81c)
---
|
---

We appreciate your time and commitment to making a positive change in our community. Together, we can bridge the gap, have a working-class candidate work for you, and build toward a future that benefits us all.Thank you for being an integral part of our movement.
|

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=298f3d1ee43142d6aafa82f428e9170d&_e=PMOgk4PCE8Lfr5DPXQIugWepHo064MDZgIQDgKFqDulubufaVaiF0aLj5UhBEvjD8X6PVR_Lg9Xf0h0aGTcYVNXhjgmt1eTbj-anC9FmmQUAx3xmYzQ1Gj6a7QCdgwBY42B7oQV5j95bLMWPZWEFz8dMoqM9OlZBwGyOYFsdY-YTwrIWXFYEGu8Z2Vi6EWiSgQTgRWjWQmWhHRwXUh3ZCwi5xE0ptli9FSjJ574rnDbJg3AGyxTQxbU9hJ4FUck1HL2rbltZFLldzpB6kZ8R_elrOd-irbK0k7C_kS9XOE8pqkDJluyx_wmOP3C8xmX6aqDPtZ_pMK9ePi3WZ3DIpb_fFMp458XDAh_4Tr4Y3T0%3D)**

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

clean_body: I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support | | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.
