[**Jack Martin drops out of primary race, endorses James Judge for Florida's 12th Congressional District**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=0c0cef49f3&e=00028e5542)
DADE CITY, Fla. – The Hernando County man who won more primary votes than any other challenger to Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL) during the 2022 Republican primary election in Florida’s 12th Congressional District has dropped out of the 2024 Republican primary election for the same seat and has endorsed James Judge in his place.
Jack Martin, a Christian, conservative pastor, garnered nearly 10 percent of the Republican primary election votes against Bilirakis in 2022, leading all primary challengers. He announced earlier this year that he would run against Bilirakis again during the 2024 election cycle, but due to an unforeseen illness in his family, he announced Thursday he has decided to step away from politics.
Upon the announcement that he will not seek the Republican nomination for Congress in Florida’s 12th Congressional District, Martin endorsed James Judge, who is also vying to unseat Bilirakis.
“I ran against Congressman Bilirakis in 2022 because I think it’s time for change in our Florida’s 12th Congressional District,” said Martin. “I feel the same way now, which is why I planned to run again in 2024. But due to the serious illness of a family member, I cannot devote the necessary time or energy to a full-fledged political campaign. I believe James Judge shares my conservative values and vision for our country, that’s why I’m endorsing him in his primary challenge against Gus.”
Judge thanked Martin for his support.
“I’ll certainly be praying for a miracle for Jack and his family during this difficult time,” said Judge. “I’m extremely grateful to have his support, and I’m looking forward to working with his supporters and all of the Republicans in the district in our effort to unseat Gus. We don’t have time for business as usual in Washington anymore, and together we can fight to reorient the Republicans in Washington towards fiscal conservatism, reducing inflation, closing our borders and returning to America’s traditional values.”
**About James Judge:**
James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a small ranch in Dade City, with their five dogs, three cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.

_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

Justice For COVID Tyranny
------------------------------------------------------------
After Tuesday November 7th's special runoff election ended with Democratic incumbent Raphael Warnock maintaining a 1+ Dem seat majority in the senate, post-midterms, the U.S. government, lawmakers at Capitol Hill, and mainstream media pundits trudge along with "business as usual".

2. Support Candidates with Money, Fundraising people to hold events, provide a social media following for them, Church connections so they have a stage to reach the masses. We feel that candidates that have leverage are candidates that win. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. California’s Republican presidential primary and our Senate primary elections both fall on Super Tuesday, March 5. Trump’s legions of MAGA supporters are all eligible to vote in our Senate primary election. We will have to respond to Trump’s lies and attacks by then.

Because it shows he is afraid of me. And he should be. I hold him accountable and don’t let him run over me like he does so many others.

So friend, rush a split contribution of any amount between Seth Moulton and my Senate campaign to help me respond to Trump’s latest vile personal attack. I need you with me today. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Trump would not attack me so often if he wasn’t terrified of seeing me elected as California’s next U.S. Senator.
With your support today, we’ll make his worst fears come true — and ensure that neither he nor any other demagogue can damage our democracy the way he did, ever again.
— Adam

body:
https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
I’m reaching out because Tennessee public schools need our help!
Republicans continue to push their private school voucher scam upon hard working Tennessee families. Make no mistake, the implementation of a widespread voucher program WILL be detrimental to public education in every corner of our state.
Good legislation continues to be ignored in favor of initiatives pushed by corporate interest groups seeking to line their pockets by privatizing education. And I won’t stand for it! I wasn’t elected to represent corporations. I was elected to represent Tennesseans.
We desperately need Democratic voices in our legislature working together to protect our freedoms and our families. Republicans want to take my seat back to continue their shameful attacks on public schools, personal liberties, women’s healthcare, school safety, libraries, common-sense gun policies, etc. I’m asking for your help to ensure that we keep District 20 blue and push back against their extremist agenda.
Rush a donation to my re-election campaign today to protect District 20. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellforsenate]
Every child, and every Tennessean, deserves to have their best interests represented in the legislature. Our public school system is being dismantled right before our eyes, and I intend to continue standing up on this front, and to represent your interests whenever Tennesseans are being threatened by harmful Republican legislation.
I can only do this with your support and investment. Thank you for your consideration at this crucially important time.
Sen. Heidi Campbell

name: Gretchen Whitmer
subject: My personal story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC**
body:
I want to take a moment to share something personal with you. |
#
---
Friend, I want to take a moment to share a deeply personal story with you. I am a survivor of sexual assault. I shared my story for the first time on the floor of the Michigan state Senate ten years ago yesterday. At the time, we were debating a dangerous bill that raised insurance costs for women who wanted to have an abortion if they were raped or had an unwanted pregnancy. It was on track to pass — and I gathered up the courage to share my story as a last-ditch effort to change enough votes to block the bill. The bill ended up passing anyway, but the outpouring of love and support I received from Michiganders reinforced my belief that I had made the right choice to share my story. It took me 20 years to tell my story, and I know that millions of women and girls across the country are scared to tell theirs out of fear that no one would believe them or they could be punished. **But I want them to know that I understand their situation. I’ve felt their pain. And as the Governor of Michigan, I will never stop fighting for them.** I signed legislation that repealed an extreme 1931 law that banned abortion without exceptions for rape or incest and criminalized nurses and doctors for doing their jobs. I signed a series of bills that expanded access to abortion care and ended politically motivated laws that make it harder for women to access healthcare. And yesterday, I signed the final piece of the _Reproductive Health Act_ into law which repealed the same extreme, anti-choice bill we were debating ten years ago when I stood up and shared my story. This is personal to me. The pain that sexual assault survivors have to carry every single day is unbearable, and I will do whatever I can to fight for them. Friend,

What University campuses are exploding with a disturbing spectacle: students gathering _not in the name of peace_ but to celebrate the heinous acts of violence and terror perpetrated by Hamas against Israelis.

Numerous law students from top schools signed letters explicitly saying that Israelis deserved to be killed.

Even when prestigious law firms rescinded offers from law students at NYU, Harvard, and Columbia, certain segments of the academic community still endorsed these demonstrations, and administrators failed to condemn these acts unequivocally, appealing to these students' right to express their opinions.

**American universities are championing terror in the name of free speech.**

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

We want to make sure that President Zelenskyy knows that we still stand with him.
#
Derek: President Zelenskyy is visiting our nation’s capital today.
He’ll be meeting members of the Senate, the House (including Speaker Mike Johnson), and heading to the White House.
He brings the same message that we’ve worked to spread over the last two years. Ukraine defends not only their own country, but all democratic nations. If Ukraine is defeated by Russia, it will be American Troops who are called in to stop Putin as he marches across Europe to re-establish the Soviet bloc.
The only person who benefits from inaction on aid for Ukraine is Putin.
This is clear to every American who truly cares about our security — but not, apparently, in the GOP.
So we want to make sure that President Zelenskyy knows that we still stand with him. That we will not abandon Ukraine.

name: Zach Shrewsbury
subject: Hear me out
body:
Every day presents an opportunity to learn.

| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaFWyDXM8xgfrsTCr2atdYY6ZGAos--y6ALYF1btkkFH&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121223_hear_me_out_palestine&n=1)
---
Dear Friend, Hear me out. This email will be a bit long, but I need to share this with you. I did not grow up in an environment where conversations about Israel and Palestine were commonplace. We were a working-class family in a small community, and foreign policy issues were not frequently discussed. We were neither Jews nor Arabs. My family has been in West Virginia for centuries, and our world was insulated. I didn't have access to the kind of liberal arts education where history is examined from different perspectives. In the Marines, my training did not include a deep dive into the events that led to Nakba in 1948, which, by the way, means "the catastrophe" in Arabic. I am from the same cloth as most Americans; I am a working West Virginian. **As a future U.S. Senator, I'm dedicated to deepening my knowledge and understanding of current events' historical and legal context because the responsibility to and the influence this country has over millions of people in faraway lands is enormous. I don't take this power lightly.** Our media industry often sensationalizes terms like war, self-defense, and human shields to mold public opinion toward the monied interests of their advertisers and influential stakeholders and the system that allows them to rake in incredible profit at the expense of truth and balanced reporting. As I broaden my context, I'm learning what these terms mean under the International Human Rights Law that we as a country claim to support and yet so rarely honor.
* The term "war" is used intentionally to create the impression that what is going on between Israel and Palestinians is a conflict between two autonomous states. That cannot be further from the truth, as Israel is the occupier, and Hamas is the governing body of the occupied territory but not a sovereign government.
* Israel has obligations under international law to provide services and ensure the safety of its occupied population. On October 7th, when Hamas attacked, they had the right to use police powers to apprehend the criminals and prosecute them but not to use their massive military might against an essentially defenseless people. We cannot use the "right to defense" language describing Israel's revenge that has so far killed approximately 18,000 Palestinians, two-thirds of whom are women and children.
* In the context of international law, using human shields means actually putting a civilian in front of a military vehicle or combatants while advancing on the enemy. It doesn't mean having combatants living or even operating in the areas civilians occupy. Using human shields is a war crime. Israel uses the human shield argument to justify their illegal, immoral, massive-scale attacks on civilians and civilian infrastructure. Israel wants to drive the Palestinians out of Gaza.

If you want a U.S. Senator who takes seriously the treaties we as a country signed, stands firmly on the side of human rights for everyone everywhere, and responsibly yields the power vested in his office, **[support our campaign today generously.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaFWyDXM8xgfrsTCr2atdYY6ZGAos--y6ALYF1btkkFH&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121223_hear_me_out_palestine&n=2) ** I'm the only Democrat running for the U.S. Senate in West Virginia. [**Your contribution today will add a strong voice for human rights in the Senate and protect it from a MAGA Republican majority.**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaFWyDXM8xgfrsTCr2atdYY6ZGAos--y6ALYF1btkkFH&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121223_hear_me_out_palestine&n=3) With hopes for peace, Zach Shrewsbury Candidate, U.S. Senate (D-WV)

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ae50ab4fe3de48ce864c4c18cb565ef8&_e=XnTs9oGpGAGUK61s1hSQU7_t87zHu4JXBAlC3mtXKi-MDTtAYJ-5-gVEQYzg8g4EDEW55bkRl5hXvAy0v7cFub4OxWjiEcURdcU5QP_d4R7vRBxbOXLtHcGp6RS6BrHg-hLEL5nNAsQgFnPZM6R1oFON8bzsYJEUbFoz_yCwdoa7QO2oIeVKlIFjP9E3f9eZN5yvXnTkiv5TdSy5C1RL-aRPCzhig8w_J-E8MHvo5pT2dJoSMrO4vzIyREj3GJL9XXT6Xwzct5q3ir8_PO_PJN2sjj352a2c9iPmRPuic130EzDNUj3Wcog3jygedMpAfdbWN248fK2vGO8bnjz6HcfSPvN9LMCJbhQcA8SibNs%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ae50ab4fe3de48ce864c4c18cb565ef8&_e=XnTs9oGpGAGUK61s1hSQU7_t87zHu4JXBAlC3mtXKi-MDTtAYJ-5-gVEQYzg8g4EDEW55bkRl5hXvAy0v7cFub4OxWjiEcURdcU5QP_d4R7vRBxbOXLtHcGp6RS6BrHg-hLEL5nNAsQgFnPZM6R1oFON8bzsYJEUbFoz_yCwdoa7QO2oIeVKlIFjP9E3f9eZN5yvXnTkiv5TdSy5C1RL-Yy2KFPYuG4zvke0ZbWQ6DFJWTGzhF0-FxOLPKOc0UjFAnfJormD6DPdsNSIGOTKOzzE6va7Q8icKtY1Z9ffFy78_-DdXANoCu0D0wy_SwL9pqZ-4FqeghaIN-a-wjy8N90RCH0bj9aIBHGn5iQ3IBs%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Service Before Self. That’s one of three Air Force core values instilled in new recruits from their first day of basic training. Each time I put on the uniform, the airmen I encounter remind me that Service Before Self is alive and well in the United States military. Thank God for that.

Last week, I was honored to receive the endorsement of SEAL PAC, the largest and most impactful conservative, pro-veteran political action committee in the United States. SEAL PAC is committed to helping more veterans get elected to Congress, where the number of Representatives with military experience is near historic lows. You can read about the endorsement [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=c2679bace8&e=1090c5c412).

This week, my father, Col Willard Dellicker (Ret.), will honor veterans by participating in the Wreaths Across America ceremony in Allentown. My nephew, Ensign Nolan Hernandez, will continue planning for his upcoming naval flight training in Pensacola, Florida. And my son, Sergeant Will Dellicker, will prepare for his pending overseas deployment with the Army National Guard. Including my 28 years in the military, the Dellicker men have 80 years of consecutive service among us, dating back to my grandfather, Maj Willard Dellicker (Ret.), who flew P-38’s in the Army Air Force during World War II.

This week also launches our series of holiday charity events to benefit four outstanding local organizations that epitomize Service Before Self. These receptions are open to the public and free to attendees. We just ask that you bring one of the requested items that we can collect and donate to the respective charity. Here are the upcoming events:

**What:[Allentown Rescue Mission](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=716df09a59&e=1090c5c412) for Homeless Men ([Details Here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=cb377711ba&e=1090c5c412))**
**Event:** Thu., Dec. 14th from 6-8 PM at [Korny’s Tavern](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=e1eab705ed&e=1090c5c412)\- 2228 Old Post Rd, Coplay
**Donation items:** Bed linens, socks, underwear, t-shirts, personal care items, etc.

**What:[Victory House Lehigh Valley](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=ad5def85a7&e=1090c5c412) for Homeless Vets and Men ([Details Here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=8c425c096b&e=1090c5c412))**
**Event:** Sat., Dec. 16th at 12:00 at the [Original Doughboys Pizza and Family Restaurant](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=30e0fab83e&e=1090c5c412)**-** 230 W Moorestown Rd, Wind Gap
**Donation items:** Pillowcases, Twin XL sheets, Underwear, Socks, T-shirts, etc.

**What:****[Care Net](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=787f1ab046&e=1090c5c412) for Women Needing Maternal Care ([Details Here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=a7a94c88d7&e=1090c5c412))**
**Event:** Mon., Dec.18th from 6-8 PM at [The Batter's Box Sports Bar & Grille](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=cde499c6cc&e=1090c5c412), 10 E Lehigh St, Summit Hill
**Donation items:** Various gift cards for shopping (think grocery, Walmart, target, gas) & sanitary products for young women (tampons, pads), Size 5 & 6 diapers, etc.

**What:[Valor Clinic](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=d0094c1468&e=1090c5c412) for Homeless Veterans ([Details Here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=0fcee59615&e=1090c5c412))**
**Event:** Thu., Dec. 21 from 6-8 PM at [Cherry Family Restaurant](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=950d7d4d84&e=1090c5c412), 593 Interchange Rd, Kresgeville
**Donation items:** Sweatpants, Hoodies, L-XXL, bar soap, disposable razors, deodorant, etc.

To RSVP please email Michelle Jarrouj-Weaver [michelle@dellickerforcongress.com](mailto:michelle@dellickerforcongress.com).

Details about all four events are available [here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=195059bfa0&e=1090c5c412).

You don’t need to serve in the military to demonstrate Service Before Self. Please join us in helping our neighbors in need during this Christmas season.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father to three sons. He’s not a career politician. He’s an experienced leader with the courage and expertise to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=acd3e17119&e=1090c5c412).

Friend, [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75048770/443438082/-1405467182?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTRhMjdjZS0yMDk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QaVGvW1LY8XYqMCGp_oH5xRnu335e20twfjR6V3dii8=&emci=734a6ee2-7098-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=9a4a27ce-2099-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=14565883) Yesterday was the filing deadline for congressional candidates, and I officially have a Democrat opponent. **My primary election is less than 3 months away **and my team and I will be knocking doors, registering voters, and talking to constituents all across the county to make sure they understand how important 2024 is. Many of you have asked how you can help, so here are a few ways to get involved: 1\. **[Register Here to Volunteer](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75048771/443438111/1016227774?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTRhMjdjZS0yMDk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QaVGvW1LY8XYqMCGp_oH5xRnu335e20twfjR6V3dii8=&emci=734a6ee2-7098-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=9a4a27ce-2099-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=14565883)** \-- we'll need blockwalkers, texters, postcard writers and more. 2\. **[Make a Contribution](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75048772/443438113/1516981626?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MTY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTRhMjdjZS0yMDk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QaVGvW1LY8XYqMCGp_oH5xRnu335e20twfjR6V3dii8=)** \-- We're already designing mailers, yard signs, and door hangers. Your contributions help fuel my campaign and voter contact! 3\. **Make sure your family and friends are registered to vote** \-- The 2024 elections are incredibly important. Start talking to your friends and family now about registering to vote, or updating their registration. It's the honor of my life to represent my hometown in Congress, friend. I'm ready to hit the streets and remind voters what's at stake this election. Whether you're a donor, volunteer, or community advocate, I'm so thankful for your support. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. One week ago, we launched an ambitious new voter registration program to
help Democrats win elections in Texas.

When we started recruiting for the kickoff, we budgeted for around 1,000
volunteers to join us on Zoom to get trained on how to help register
voters. But the response wildly exceeded our expectations — over 13,000
volunteers signed up!

Great problem to have, but it meant we had to upgrade our Zoom space to
accommodate everyone — a $7,000 expense for this one training. (And a
solid reminder that leading the largest voter registration effort in Texas
will require a lot of resources.)

any amount you can today?

Your contribution will ensure we can plan for the long-haul and keep up
this momentum. Giving $5, $10, or even $20 a month will allow us to:

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ded917cd86274c129c6b7b3f12ba628c&_e=Nh7L4c7AsyS3wWhBxjf8WgoWe8KylLSJqSixo8p-1Ees-Ghhr9ZpJiwYCC-HClYBGlGVS3Y_7u9ltfAEPYnxnwxqcWDyjF41zaxQhN57g6OBJiVmIaSpWrZ6trN3er8t22S8hCwvxLYMS6Ns825cnFCp5-ZFRR6KeetElePPWmZTfWWmVEHEskg7V1PD7tZWnl9becj5xfLRztiRsRB3vHL-F7l0BIaF0g_rUTVkR6D5AKD5iSQ74sXuiyDZH04i0Xv6Ql5e6feokLhbJ3M97WgzkPe_QBbeYarFiP1Nxwm4Gly3VvI1rZD1xwp9sXBTLRl6DkhiTUsalsVBV4uoiOw6sdVbTv5eApmwOjx39fBWmkXUAVCXT5Ftk71C7_Wh3c_Rauce9S4DVHRZuuWeHw%3D%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

It’s been nearly a week since the presidents of Harvard, the University of Pennsylvania, and MIT- under oath in front of Congress - declined to say that hateful rhetoric on their campuses, including calling for the genocide of Jews, constituted hate speech according to their school’s code of conduct.

_**My opponent, Montana Democrat Jon Tester, has said nothing.**_

His silence is deafening.

I want to know your stance on this, Fellow Conservative. Please drop what you’re doing and spend 30 seconds answering a few questions on my mind over the last couple of days.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ded917cd86274c129c6b7b3f12ba628c&_e=Nh7L4c7AsyS3wWhBxjf8WgoWe8KylLSJqSixo8p-1Ees-Ghhr9ZpJiwYCC-HClYBGlGVS3Y_7u9ltfAEPYnxnwxqcWDyjF41zaxQhN57g6OBJiVmIaSpWrZ6trN3er8t22S8hCwvxLYMS6Ns825cnFCp5-ZFRR6KeetElePPWmZTfWWmVEHEskg7V1PD7tZWnl9becj5xfLRztiRsRB3vHL-F7l0BIaF0g_rUTVkR6D5AKD5iSQ74sXuiyDZH04iIC2zA_KAFMYh6ywUe1qQ_HbDTGCMcY4UdeMsuMLh5uIO1q36l9dSktgcDct6BtWLlpX9MxdkxAhbj_p0yjFPPMKe0nr4up1UxYC5wO8_AqcA5NRR8NfCbGyEQoEPzOlxFyQkenfVhgOCP08Q6h_eVg%3D%3D)
[**DOES ISRAEL HAVE THE RIGHT TO EXIST?
LET US KNOW->** ](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ded917cd86274c129c6b7b3f12ba628c&_e=Nh7L4c7AsyS3wWhBxjf8WgoWe8KylLSJqSixo8p-1Ees-Ghhr9ZpJiwYCC-HClYBGlGVS3Y_7u9ltfAEPYnxnwxqcWDyjF41zaxQhN57g6OBJiVmIaSpWrZ6trN3er8t22S8hCwvxLYMS6Ns825cnFCp5-ZFRR6KeetElePPWmZTfWWmVEHEskg7V1PD7tZWnl9becj5xfLRztiRsRB3vHL-F7l0BIaF0g_rUTVkR6D5AKD5iSQ74sXuiyDZH04ivWjpnvZuf7XxoC-nnD4gl3_ng2VGzt4oFAXpd4wS9UKWMDNtIqTjDo9wHAkZ7Bs1WbxCzJPpOtD7gfeJASyWB7J7irNddVKZpoo_pPCBtokyCiZ338vsnH2dIIUBEShTozFwK5AjaKluOBXo-zMBGw%3D%3D)

The testimony by all three university heads was _**pathetic**_. The testimony each of the three women who sat in front of Congress yesterday gave was not only dehumanizing toward the Jewish people, but _**it also sent a clear message to the enemies of Israel in America that their hate toward Jews is acceptable on college campuses across our country**_.

Meanwhile, over on Twitter, Jon Tester wasn’t posting about the importance of defending Israel or condemning hate speech against Jewish Americans - **he was posting about butchering meat.**

As a former Navy SEAL and current U.S. Senate candidate, defending America’s right to exist, our freedom, and the values that we stand for are always at the forefront of everything I do in life. Hi Peter,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=5cfbf439fd734231a389c0cbae760152&_e=I7vV5FIjscnLr9MNsleeNrdoW1dnoKr8WtjI5JfkI9oj0sFDWedODaNniiwGVDTpCL7AgA7spLS_X5kYCyC3lALwm8s29C01WxoL8p21DN7cpBb2pB9GSwRd-Y-tbj0ysvIexWcPtYmOKzZOqk8IYUtkWX5cVLlkyZ6GU0roeLlcfmy3DKJYi9lHLwZBXmYfQIC_CEcXqT0-VNBYoE5-xvxZq-sX-C49cYktKcGHfSYtCBxV200ujpYsiwRsOUTXjHup6QLGYS3Q_xEJY5tIQB6nw32a4G3nhoLg70A7NvFwi1AOCjefdO8PRGuF8u8Vuc2efxFRIIvkCFwLzIUwRG6gawwoFGYyb-e3K6SVmGcwnpoGOaRe1sj_1P2Dco4T)**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable._**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=5cfbf439fd734231a389c0cbae760152&_e=I7vV5FIjscnLr9MNsleeNrdoW1dnoKr8WtjI5JfkI9oj0sFDWedODaNniiwGVDTpCL7AgA7spLS_X5kYCyC3lALwm8s29C01WxoL8p21DN7cpBb2pB9GSwRd-Y-tbj0ysvIexWcPtYmOKzZOqk8IYUtkWX5cVLlkyZ6GU0roeLlcfmy3DKJYi9lHLwZBXmYfQIC_CEcXqT0-VNBYoE5-xvxZq-sX-C49cYktKcGHfSb-WCsirWHdVprYYRUfTF5IZJ8whB0y_wlSCo6F7JjaWSBL7VF_kFLCy1nSCuNWgLKlFEow2OOQjeXIBTJnQPPbNysnHF31sGCLg2jZ2gxPBOwf8jQeJ1sAmAVzbsnLTbNYYnjhWUI7pgROubIgE-aF)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.** ➡️

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.
---
| | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=5cfbf439fd734231a389c0cbae760152&_e=I7vV5FIjscnLr9MNsleeNrdoW1dnoKr8WtjI5JfkI9oj0sFDWedODaNniiwGVDTpCL7AgA7spLS_X5kYCyC3lALwm8s29C01WxoL8p21DN7cpBb2pB9GSwRd-Y-tbj0ysvIexWcPtYmOKzZOqk8IYUtkWX5cVLlkyZ6GU0roeLlcfmy3DKJYi9lHLwZBXmYfQIC_CEcXqT0-VNBYoE5-xvxZq-sX-C49cYktKcGHfSZG5QmY6ATqVf34AViF9HKBHR2Ump59nZMayiHjlozzOBhyM6Nc9Ca8lEX-Yu0DrWKVi0d6yYEnIAyxMUOQY-NhPB8Azu4Utso_qVSREqgpypgReFOv0zCBN1rTjVkaSu-WJ_5yvhBbSONkcW9ds9cJ)
---

Hey friend,

Ron DeSantis was just asked about his thoughts on situation in Israel. In case you missed his answer and didn’t know, we wanted to FWD you over his response to the situation. See below:

--------Forwarded Message--------

From:
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79
Ron DeSantis

Subject: This atrocity is personal to me

Friend,

The atrocity we’re seeing unfold in Israel is personal to me.

I served in Iraq starting in 2007 and the casualties our troops suffered were at the hands of Iranian-backed Shia militias. American troops were killed, and Iran was responsible. In 1983, through Hezbollah, American Marines were bombed in their barracks in Beirut, and Iran was responsible.

The Iranian regime has American blood on its hands, and it is their religious and ideological worldview to continue to fund terrorists. We should be turning every screw to make sure that they are not getting a penny of our resources flowing into their terrorist-backing coffers.

We should be standing with our ally Israel as they root out Hamas. Joe Biden should not be considering any sort of practical rapprochement with a regime who is funding barbarous murder, rape, kidnapping, and the beheading of babies. It's absolutely despicable.

Here in Florida, I am using every available resource to support Israelis and cut off every source of funding for the Iranians. We are strengthening our sanctions and reinforcing our commitment to do no business with state sponsors of terrorists.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79

This is something that we should all agree on, unanimously. This is not a party issue. Our country should be drying up Iran’s ability to fund terrorism, not protesting in support of Hamas.

This is personal to me. This is personal to my state. With the second largest Israeli-American population in the country, the people across the communities I serve have friends and family members that have either gone missing or been brutally murdered in recent days. These emotions are raw.

As President, I would not be okay with the liberal institutions across this country siding with Hamas and leading pro-Hamas demonstrations. I would be reversing Biden’s disastrous open-border policies so that terrorists could not attack our vulnerabilities and enter our country armed with weapons, drugs, and intent to harm. And we would be expanding our sanctions so that American money never lines the pockets of the terrorist-backing Iranian regime.

We must focus on what matters and condemn the antisemitism mobilizing this appalling horror. Joe Biden isn’t getting the job done. We need a President who is going to be disciplined, focused, and put the mission first. Joe Biden is not that guy, but I am. When I am President, we will use every available resource to end the facilitation of these despicable acts.

If you’d like to support my campaign, please consider chipping in at the link below. Please, don't feel pressured. This time is difficult time and I understand if you do not want to provide resources to a political campaign during this crisis. Please know that I will always appreciate your support, no matter what form it takes.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79
SUPPORT RON DESANTIS FOR PRESIDENT

I know this is personal, and we won’t sit idly by. We will stand with Israel; not just today, not just tomorrow, but always.

Yours in Freedom,

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79

Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79

🚨 ATTENTION 🚨

Heads up! We have pre-checked the monthly donor box on our fundraising page. Monthly donors make a HUGE difference for our team and help ups plan ahead.

If one donation was all it took to defeat Joe Biden next November then we wouldn't ask for your help more than we already have, but unfortunately it's going to take more than that to win.

Please keep this box checked so we that we can count on your support.

Volunteer!

We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e39b38835a0b502334e7694a06ee309b96de69935a17e865a54ffa41f31b33c9c7470246de68681161ac21d200ae3e9e9e5ce8c11b5b57f27
Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=87ec97802d349d0e3d5a701ba7bc9a55fc726486626c70b3d465529ba44cc2d81df5b602eb5a384ce2fb72c221a8e4c4e585e698301093c78041f58053980e79

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

It’s been nearly a week since the presidents of Harvard, the University of Pennsylvania, and MIT- under oath in front of Congress - declined to say that hateful rhetoric on their campuses, including calling for the genocide of Jews, constituted hate speech according to their school’s code of conduct.

_**My opponent, Montana Democrat Jon Tester, has said nothing.**_

Meanwhile, over on Twitter, Jon Tester wasn’t posting about the importance of defending Israel or condemning hate speech against Jewish Americans - **he was posting about butchering meat.**

The presidents of Harvard, MIT, and UPenn should lose their jobs for their failure to condemn Jewish hate, and Jon Tester should be ashamed of himself for having nothing to say about Jewish genocide.

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Don’t allow the EPA to approve neonics for another 15 years
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2192386?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: The EPA is set to APPROVE bee-killing pesticides for another 15 years -- but we can still STOP this!** Over the last two decades, the populations of critical wild bee species have PLUMMETED: **The Rusty-Patched Bumblebee population has dropped by 87%, the American Bumblebee by 89%, and the Western Bumblebee by 93%.** Research points to __**neonics**__ as a leading cause of these massive bee die-offs. The most widely used pesticides in the world, neonics have made agriculture **nearly 50 times more toxic** to insects. Neonics are __**EXTREMELY DEADLY TO BEES.**__ They attack bees’ nervous systems and can harm their ability to navigate, find food, fight pests and diseases, and even reproduce. [**If we’re going to protect wild bees and other pollinators from being wiped out, we MUST demand an end to the widespread use of bee-killing neonics. Will you take action NOW to help SAVE WILD BEES before it’s too late?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2192387?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2192388?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Bees are essential for our food chain and way of life. We rely on these helpful little pollinators for **1 out of 3 bites of food** that we eat and _**75% of the world’s most nutritious food crops**_ like fruits, veggies, and nuts. Almonds wouldn’t even EXIST if it weren’t for bees! And without bees and other pollinators, crops like coffee and chocolate would be in short supply, making them more expensive and harder to obtain.
But TOXIC bee-killing neonics are threatening critical pollinators and the health of our ecosystems. Recent studies have even shown that widespread use of neonics may be harmful to humans -- **_especially to children._**
The EU has already banned the worst neonics, and states like MD and NJ have implemented restrictions on them. **Yet the EPA is still preparing to APPROVE these DANGEROUS pesticides for _ANOTHER_ 15 years.** Wild bees can’t wait that long, Friend, so we urgently need you to take action with us before it’s too late. **[Add your name right now to PROTECT POLLINATORS from TOXIC NEONICS!>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2192389?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

---

name: Adam Schiff
subject: This can’t wait, Derek
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| We are living through a transformative moment in our nation’s history.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4737%2E5257348%2EwG1JLv)
Hi Derek, it’s Adam with an important update:
My final mid-month deadline of the year is only 3 days away — and my FEC deadline is right around the corner. We are so close to hitting our fundraising goal. If everyone reading this email chipped in just $5, we would reach it. Will you help us finish this quarter off strong, Derek?
**You can donate through this secure donation link:[secure.actblue.com/donate/dec2023_abs_em?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=dec2023_abs_em._zEiYK&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231212_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4737%2E5257348%2EwG1JLv)**
We are living through a transformative moment in our nation’s history. Our country needs leaders who are prepared to tackle its most pressing issues. And throughout my career, I've dedicated myself to exactly that.
When an aluminum company paid smugglers to haul toxic waste from California and illegally dump it across the border in Mexico, I took them to court — **and won**. That prosecution set a powerful precedent that no company, big or small, could avoid accountability when harming people and our planet.
When a Republican member of Congress refused to take action in the best interest of our community, I didn’t sit on the sidelines — **I ran against him**. In the most expensive House race in history at the time, I defeated the incumbent, turned the seat blue, and became only the second Democrat to represent it in a century.
When Californians demanded change, **I took up their call**. I've united people to expand healthcare access, reduce prescription drug costs, invest in infrastructure, and help build more affordable housing.
When our democracy was under attack, I led the investigation of Donald Trump and served as the lead manager in his first impeachment trial in the Senate. Together, we secured the first bipartisan vote **ever** to convict a sitting president.
**And when Ted Cruz, Josh Hawley, Rick Scott, and Tommy Tuberville voted to overturn the results of the 2020 election in the Senate and enabled Trump’s MAGA mob to storm the Capitol, I helped conduct the investigation on the January 6 Committee to hold all of them accountable.**
**And I can’t wait to do even more in the Senate.**
I’m not afraid of rolling up my sleeves to deliver results. I’m ready to continue our shared work in Congress so every Californian — and folks all over the country — can live out their dream. **But I can’t do it alone.**
**Derek, I don't accept a dime from corporate PACs, so I rely on your support to compete with the GOP's megadonors. Will you rush in $5 before my mid-month deadline to help bring our fight to the halls of the U.S. Senate? Here’s that personal donation link one more time:[secure.actblue.com/donate/dec2023_abs_em?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=dec2023_abs_em._zEiYK&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231212_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4737%2E5257348%2EwG1JLv)**
Thank you.

When a Republican member of Congress refused to take action in the best interest of our community, I didn’t sit on the sidelines — I ran against him. In the most expensive House race in history at the time, I defeated the incumbent, turned the seat blue, and became only the second Democrat to represent it in a century. When Californians demanded change, I took up their call. I've united people to expand healthcare access, reduce prescription drug costs, invest in infrastructure, and help build more affordable housing. When our democracy was under attack, I led the investigation of Donald Trump and served as the lead manager in his first impeachment trial in the Senate. Together, we secured the first bipartisan vote ever to convict a sitting president. And when Ted Cruz, Josh Hawley, Rick Scott, and Tommy Tuberville voted to overturn the results of the 2020 election in the Senate and enabled Trump’s MAGA mob to storm the Capitol, I helped conduct the investigation on the January 6 Committee to hold all of them accountable. And I can’t wait to do even more in the Senate. I’m not afraid of rolling up my sleeves to deliver results. I’m ready to continue our shared work in Congress so every Californian — and folks all over the country — can live out their dream. But I can’t do it alone. Derek, I don't accept a dime from corporate PACs, so I rely on your support to compete with the GOP's megadonors. Will you rush in $5 before my mid-month deadline to help bring our fight to the halls of the U.S. Senate? Here’s that personal donation link one more time: Thank you. — Adam | | 135 E. Fellow Conservative,

It’s been nearly a week since the presidents of Harvard, the University of Pennsylvania, and MIT- under oath in front of Congress - declined to say that hateful rhetoric on their campuses, including calling for the genocide of Jews, constituted hate speech according to their school’s code of conduct.

_**My opponent, Montana Democrat Jon Tester, has said nothing.**_

His silence is deafening.

I want to know your stance on this, Fellow Conservative. Please drop what you’re doing and spend 30 seconds answering a few questions on my mind over the last couple of days.

this is our first step to retaking the House [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP19/1/72722/images/Screenshot%202023-12-12%20at%202.17.43%20PM.png] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Hi there, it's Tom Suozzi. I’m the Democratic nominee in the special election to replace George Santos.
I wanted to tell you a bit more about why this race is so important to me.
My father was born in Italy, and like so many, his family came in search of the American Dream. He found it in New York, and I’m so grateful he did. He taught my brother and sister and I to work hard and to work for our community. He inspired my public service as Mayor of Glen Cove, Nassau County Executive, and U.S. Representative.
But increasingly, the American Dream is out of reach for so many. The cost of living is way too high, people don’t feel safe on the streets, and our leaders are too busy with arguments and petty politics to solve problems like climate change or our broken immigration system.
And to make matters worse, George Santos represented NY-03 for 11 months, in which he did nothing other than distract and divide us until he was finally expelled.
Now, there’s a special election in NY-03 on February 13, and I’m humbly asking for your support. This race is a toss-up, so grassroots support really matters. We need to bring sanity back to our government so we can rebuild the American Dream. Can I count on you to pitch in now?

| | | | | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=50779e5bab9e4fd8a3cb81bd7ae48726&_e=mTrrtEh-HcyMVlrXXdkbDky_yvIUIdVUzk-q4VxNWNuxnYbZ1DHgM6ksNwfQA00GcENEHEsGKs7ywa5cC1vtteVTx1x7JYrGYp9D5A44IqQ4aj-SqF8n-847H8bvl0LlL88gNdV9RVasf9Uigi2HyByF_0Afoh-MYMLusXLfv7mFfhGmzGf1C8InYQP7-rrkuTLtWjPm8KVhYF0rn3Ba0xp9AKGSo_4b3QpgIuGVA7L7By5DFqJ9Rug3-qnX8P21HuWGsVLnka7p9CZxnLZs57u2DLbAxlDCJ8pfj7L7aA_wVbsqC3drRUwXNmzvcyrqFWyRYw2U7UruAL_2ytAk560mB2z3vfY4vzRoeJ2S5dGY3SUxYhmWHwgjLVmJu1RX)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.** ➡️

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.
---
| | [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=50779e5bab9e4fd8a3cb81bd7ae48726&_e=mTrrtEh-HcyMVlrXXdkbDky_yvIUIdVUzk-q4VxNWNuxnYbZ1DHgM6ksNwfQA00GcENEHEsGKs7ywa5cC1vtteVTx1x7JYrGYp9D5A44IqQ4aj-SqF8n-847H8bvl0LlL88gNdV9RVasf9Uigi2HyByF_0Afoh-MYMLusXLfv7mFfhGmzGf1C8InYQP7-rrkuTLtWjPm8KVhYF0rn3Ba0xp9AKGSo_4b3QpgIuGVA7KtVnKCfGhiL9q6Ine5y7atcS4yHmp1E7e9y5bi2fSjBJz_N_M_7dZz5FuglWttmI4Izns_492tNjr91dHt67gkgz_ULqWCpJ6u8Hb-5DjgfLBSsWNReNLkajZZgwzr-tlErshSve5HXbMhyyPwAUKf)
---
When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

clean_body: Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you. | | | | | Hi Fellow Conservative, Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you. Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable.Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. | | When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | - I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. body:

Momentum is on our side
Last cycle, considering redistricting, Bob Lorinser moved the needle for Democrats by more than five points in rural Northern Michigan.
This round, with an early start, ballot name recognition, and a more organized, more robust field team, we're proud to say we're stronger than ever — over 200% better-funded than we were at this stage in 2021.
But we still have a long way to go.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Birthday.png]
To create change in rural America, we need Democrats committed to long-term, two-cycle strategies. This is our opportunity!
Grassroots fundraising will play a huge role in obtaining the resources we need to defeat the GOP in 2024. Friend, can you chip in just $5? Every dollar counts. [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
CONTRIBUTE $5 [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
actblue.com/donate/about-bob [actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
Momentum is crucial when it comes to winning, and that's where we need your help.
In 2022, feeling pressure of polls trending our way, Rep. Jack Bergman used corporate PAC and dark money to spend $600,000 in the last two weeks of the campaign to launch a dishonest attack ad campaign.
Despite the defeat, Bob vowed to persevere, regroup, re-strategize, and enhance our campaign infrastructure, outreach, and volunteer base to continue the good fight.
To put rural America back on the map for Democrats in 2024, Bob Lorinser remains committed to positive change. We're not after ultra wealthy affluent donors with big pocketbooks or unethical PAC money. Instead, we're galvanizing support from tens of thousands of people all over our district and the country.
Our average donation is just $35.
We may be out funded , but we have more individual donors than any candidate in the race, and it's because voters know Dr. Bob is hands-down one of the most qualified candidates to ever run in our district.
He's taken the time to hold over 400 town halls and meet and greets, listening to voters in every corner of our 35 counties. He's learned, studied and understands what it takes to move our district forward.
With your help, Dr. Bob won't stop fighting to show Jack Bergman and the GOP that democratic principles are winning principles.
As we approach the end of this fundraising quarter, we need an extra boost from generous supporters like you to further extend our strength. Thank you for considering giving us a holiday boost.
Sincerely,
Team Dr. Bob

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

Friend,
For almost a year, Alabama Senator Tommy Tuberville held up hundreds of military promotions in protest of a Pentagon policy that expanded access to reproductive care.
After the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, more than 40% of active duty servicewomen were left stationed in states with little to no access to reproductive care. In response, the Department of Defense instituted a policy that allowed time off and travel reimbursement for service members who have to travel out of state for reproductive care, like abortions or IVF.
To “protest” this policy, Tuberville began a blockade of military promotions — at one point even blocking a seat on the Joint Chiefs of Staff. Over nine months, he prevented over 400 service members from receiving their hard-earned promotions.
No one fought harder against Tuberville’s ridiculous blockade than Michael. He was the first to call on Tuberville to end his charade, and has continued to do so.
Last week, Tuberville finally agreed to lift his blockade of promotions — except those at the highest level.
Michael won’t stop fighting until this stunt is over and service members have full access to reproductive care. Will you support him by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_121223_Tuberville_act]

subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. name: South Bay CRA
subject: Tonights Christmas party
body:
Tonights Christmas Party News Friends, The holiday season is upon us, and we are thrilled to invite you to our upcoming Christmas Party on Tuesday
| |
---
|
---
# Tonights Christmas Party
---
---
|
---
# News
Friends,
The holiday season is upon us, and we are thrilled to invite you to our upcoming Christmas Party on Tuesday Dec, 12th at 7 pm. We can't wait to celebrate with you and spread some holiday cheer!
The party will be a night full of fun and excitement, with plenty of opportunities to make new memories and cherish old ones. We encourage everyone to wear their best Christmas outfits to add to the festive mood of the night. We will also have a professional photographer on hand to capture the best moments of the night so you can cherish them forever.
As a highlight of the evening, we will be presenting two Republicans of the Year awards, recognizing the outstanding contributions of our community members to our party. You won't want to miss this exciting moment!
We hope you can join us for this joyous occasion. Please RSVP so we can plan accordingly. We look forward to celebrating the holiday season with you and many candidates running for local office! We will be holding the event at Rock & Brews in Redondo Beach (Torrance address)
Sincerely,
**Nena Gates**
President
nenarenae2@gmail.com
In addition please see the press release statement from my husband Derrick Gates below.
## Christmas Party
---
|
---
|
---
# JOIN THE SBCRA TODAY
If you want to Join the fight, you can get started at this link!
[CLICK TO JOIN THE SOUTH BAY CRA](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/4872?id=50004.80.1.fbf4b094c04a45a5f346df46201e7c94)
Dear friends and fellow Conservatives, I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State Party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee. As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member. While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future. I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond. Thank you for your support and dedication to our party. Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates
[Click for officialderrickgates.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/4872?id=50004.81.1.fbdf6607d7c7d9c9b00284df22535c54)

I'd like to explain something before **[I ask you to pitch in toward my re-election campaign’s final mid-month goal of the year.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75060103/443477204/-1625608466?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20231212_PM1_T1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDZiZGYzNi00NTk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zJ_0AEPixhwEtZk-nIu8bBwgRlPkGIqCKfplPbUQnQc=)** We are only a few weeks away from our end-of-year fundraising deadline. This will be our most important fundraising report yet. From Mitch McConnell-aligned super PACs desperate to see him back in power to potential Republican opponents for my campaign and campaigns we support — everyone will be poring over our numbers at the start of the election year to see if we have the resources it takes to help defend our Democratic Senate Majority. If our report looks weak, **you can bet National Republicans will flood New Mexico and battleground races with millions to try to defeat Democrats everywhere.** Frankly, our fundraising numbers are far from the only measure of the strength of our grassroots team. Your fervent support for making our shared values a reality — like protecting reproductive rights, enacting common-sense gun safety measures, and preserving our public lands and waters for future generations — is critical to the success of our campaign. I will never take that support for granted. **But Republicans don't understand what our values mean to us. Instead, they are hyper-focused on the numbers. That's why it's important we come together to deliver a strong report.** **[The future of our Senate Majority is hanging in the balance, and stepping up now can make a real difference in the results we see on Election Day. Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75060228/443477621/1610638071?refcode=em20231212pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=b274bdca-4599-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMjc0YmRjYS00NTk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5dD9uocKxMON6DK92Pnsx_Ziq7Uaz6n-PjrjqLFkBRE=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**My opponent, Lauren Boebert, wants you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is Boebert pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Boebert’s views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing her seat in Congress last year, Lauren Boebert might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But she’s only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024.**

clean_body: Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. Hello, Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before Roe v. Wade ... = Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats. Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue. My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy. My opponent, Lauren Boebert, wants you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not. What’s extreme is Boebert pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages. Boebert’s views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor. I would have thought that after almost losing her seat in Congress last year, Lauren Boebert might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But she’s only doubled down on the extreme. Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for letting me share some of my story with you.
