body:
Alexandria’s fight just got tougher.
#
Just this afternoon, New York’s highest court threw out the state's congressional lines.
All of New York’s congressional districts, including ours, must be redrawn. That means, with just a few months until Election Day, we have no idea where Alexandria is running for reelection, or who she’s running against.
It could be months before the new districts are finalized, which means our campaign will have just a few short weeks to reach voters in Alexandria’s new district before our June primary. A new challenger with huge resources could come up out of nowhere to take advantage of the chaos.
We have to be ready for anything, and we need to get ready now.
[It will be all hands on deck to keep Alexandria’s seat. Will you contribute $5 today to help us fight against the Republicans coming our way and win back a majority in the House?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231212.VuaLO1&refcode=em20231212-5465-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5465%2E2526796%2E5CmGmJ)

This is the second time in two years that the district lines have been redrawn in New York. That’s extremely confusing to voters. Lots of people still don’t know who their new Member of Congress is. We are going to have to spend extra resources on voter education to make sure people know to get to the polls.
This issue is also bigger than just New York. When the lines changed last year, Republicans won four House seats — and that was the difference between Democrats or Republicans controlling Congress.
[There’s a lot on the line. subject: Last night’s decision

body:
Last night, the Texas Supreme Court held that a woman couldn't end a pregnancy when the fetus has a fatal condition — even if it would endanger her life

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1852%2E4032634%2EiYtB8m)
---
Last night, the Texas Supreme Court held that a woman couldn't end a pregnancy when the fetus has a fatal condition — even if it would endanger her life or her chance to get pregnant again. The group of judges — which is made up entirely of Republicans — reversed a previous decision from a state judge that ruled she could receive an abortion under the state’s “medical emergency” exception. This woman went to another state where she could get a legal abortion. **I’m relieved she was able to access the abortion care that she needed. But understand this: This ruling sets the precedent for future cases to come. And the Republicans' next move is for the Texas law to be the law everywhere. That means no safe havens anywhere.** Their current Republican frontrunner for president — Donald Trump — has made that intention clear. He’s boasted about being the president who “got rid of Roe v. Wade.” He supports a national ban. He even said there has to be "some form of punishment" for women who get abortions. It’s not just a campaign motto: Abortion will be on the ballot in 2024. So I’m going to pull on every lever to fight for the right to an abortion nationwide. That means campaigning against MAGA Republicans' out-of-touch extremism in order to prevent their plans for a national ban. That means electing pro-abortion Democrats and ending the filibuster so we can codify Roe v. Wade into federal law. That means reversing the right-wing takeover of our Supreme Court by working to expand and rebalance it. And that means supporting local candidates and ballot measures that will defend abortion rights at the state level. We can’t let up on our fight or let the stakes scare us. Because we’ve seen it in Kansas, in Michigan, in Ohio, and in Virginia: When abortion rights are on the ballot, abortion rights win. We are not powerless. There is a path out of this. We can still make sure this extremist court doesn’t get the final word on abortion rights. And we must. I’m in this fight all the way. [**If you’re with me, please pitch in $28 so we can keep growing our pro-abortion movement ahead of the 2024 election.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/998?amount=28&t=8&akid=1852%2E4032634%2EiYtB8m) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1688%2E35263%2EPcrcqP)
Peter — A woman in Texas sought an abortion in her home state after learning her fetus was diagnosed with a fatal condition that could threaten her future fertility if the pregnancy continued. After days of legal whiplash and threats from Texas’ Republican Attorney General, the state’s Supreme Court blocked her from obtaining an abortion — forcing her to leave the state to get the health care she needs. **This cruel system is working exactly as anti-abortion Republicans intended.** Ever since their decades-long campaign to restrict reproductive freedom culminated in the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , Republicans continue to push forward with their plan to pass a nationwide abortion ban. That’s why I reintroduced the _Women’s Health Protection Act_ — my bill to protect and restore abortion rights nationwide. I’m fighting my heart out to pass it because every person, regardless of where they live, deserves the right to make their own personal decisions about their health care without interference from far-right judges or politicians. **[Peter, will you add your name to my petition calling on Congress to pass the _Women’s Health Protection Act_ today? I’ll never back down in the fight to protect the right to choose, and it’d mean a lot to know you’re with me on this.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2312_WHPA/?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231212_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=1688%2E35263%2EPcrcqP)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2312_WHPA/?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231212_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=1688%2E35263%2EPcrcqP)

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Holding Ukraine hostage to force cruel demands: GOP plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
We did not spend years fighting this agenda under Trump only to give in to Senate Republicans’ extreme demands now.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20231212-3270-footer&t=1&akid=3270%2E420207%2Eadel6Q)
Peter,
Republicans are on the verge of pushing through the most extreme and restrictive immigration legislation in generations this week —**and they are holding Ukraine funding hostage to force these cruel and ineffective immigration policy demands.**
**I won't stand for this brinkmanship and chaos from MAGA Republicans, so I’m raising the alarm in Congress. I’ve called on my Senate colleagues to reject this ransom demand for Ukraine aid and pass thoughtful, humane reforms.**
**The GOP is fighting for policies that are so extreme they would be the most restrictive immigration legislation since the racial quota laws of the 1920s. They are the foundation of Donald Trump’s vision of ‘sweeping raids, giant camps, and mass deportations’ in a potential second term.**
**We did not spend years fighting this agenda under Trump only to give in to Republicans’ extreme demands now. We must enact humane, bipartisan reforms to our broken immigration system. We need to expand lawful pathways and provide funding to cities welcoming new asylum seekers.**
**Destroying the asylum system will not fix the southern border. Reports have shown this Republican proposal would not reduce unauthorized border crossings. It’ll only sow chaos and cruelty.**
[**If you stand with our fight, please chip in to support our stand for immigration justice and reform.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20231212.AXOUd_&refcode=em20231212-3270&t=2&akid=3270%2E420207%2Eadel6Q)
